jobs.title: Senior Recruiter | GTM Expansion
jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.

The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.

The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

• Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

• Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

• Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

• Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

• Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

• Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

• Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

• Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.

What You Need

• 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

• Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

• A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

• Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

• Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

• Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

• The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

• Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

• High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

• Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

Nice to Have

• Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

• Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

• Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.

Why this Role

You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
jobs.description:
About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

Your job is straightforward: ensure contractual monthly payments are collected, missed payments are followed up on promptly, and arrears are resolved consistently and professionally.

What We’re Looking For

You will need strong hands-on experience in credit control, collections, or recurring payment recovery, ideally within a subscription, professional services, or other high-volume customer environment.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Remote / 20% Travel

 

About forgd

forgd is the consultancy partnering exclusively with Anthropic to help enterprises build AI-native businesses. We start with engineering — helping organizations move from individual developers using Claude Code to entire teams shipping together with AI-native workflows — and expand into agentic solution delivery and broader business transformation.

Our conviction is that engineers are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. The strongest mental model for designing, deploying, and governing AI agents in production lives in software engineering. The teams that change how their organization builds software are the same teams equipped to shepherd the rest of the business into this new world.

We embed and co-build with customer teams. Cycles are short, delivery is iterative and accountable to clear outcome goals.

 

About the Role

As an FDE, you embed with enterprise customers and own the technical work across the full customer journey — initial demos, short proof-of-value engagements, and multi-week implementations. The work moves customers from interesting prototypes to production capability.

Most engagements start in engineering. You'll work with customer engineering teams adopting Claude Code and redesigning their SDLC — code review, requirements, testing, documentation, and governance. From there, the work expands: co-building agentic applications and modernizing legacy systems on the Claude developer platform, and partnering with business stakeholders to deploy agents into core operations like sales, customer service, and finance.

You're the expert in the room on how engineers work with Claude Code, what an agentic application looks like in production, and what has to change in an organization to sustain either. You build prototypes, ship code, run workshops, write specs, and make the calls that move customers from demos to deployment.

Collaborate directly with Anthropic on customer engagements — joint working sessions, early access to product changes, and a direct line to their product and engineering teams.

 

Responsibilities

Enable

Transform

  • Lead discovery into customer environments — engineering toolchains and workflows, business operations, and organizational dynamics — and turn that into clear technical plans

  • Advise on how AI-native development changes existing engineering practices: issue management, branching, testing, code review, and security

Build

  • Scope engagements: assumptions, risks, milestones, and dependencies

  • Embed with customer teams to co-build agentic applications on the Claude developer platform

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers move from proof-of-value to production

  • Accounts expand on the strength of the work

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Software development experience in a high-scale startup or enterprise environment; you know what it takes to write, ship, and operate production code

  • Production experience with LLMs — prompt engineering, agent design, and evaluation frameworks.

Nice to Have

If you're excited about AI-native engineering and want to help enterprises change how they build software, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

  • A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

  • Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

  • Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

  • Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

Vil du lede og videreutvikle virksomhetsstyringen i Patentstyret?

Patentstyret søker en avdelingsdirektør for Virksomhetsstyring som skal bidra til å videreutvikle en moderne, effektiv og fremtidsrettet organisasjon. Oppdraget vårt ligger i skjæringspunktet mellom innovasjon, næringsliv og offentlig forvaltning.

Som avdelingsdirektør for virksomhetsstyring får du en sentral rolle i Patentstyret. Du kan påvirke hvordan vi styrer, prioriterer og utvikler organisasjonen. Vi ser etter deg som vil bruke kompetansen og ledererfaringen din til å skape resultater sammen med andre. Du skal sikre gode styringsprosesser og et solid beslutningsgrunnlag for ledelsen. Du skal også bidra til at Patentstyret er godt rustet til å løse samfunnsoppdraget i årene som kommer. 

Patentstyret står foran en viktig omstilling. Teknologisk utvikling, digitalisering og kunstig intelligens, endrede brukerbehov og rammebetingelser stiller nye krav til hvordan vi styrer, prioriterer og utvikler virksomheten.

Du skal lede en avdeling med om lag 23 ansatte, inkludert et lederteam med to seksjonssjefer. Som avdelingsdirektør inngår du i Patentstyrets ledergruppe og rapporterer direkte til direktøren.

Du får mulighet til å utvikle Patentstyrets nyetablerte avdeling for virksomhetsstyring. En sentral oppgave blir å legge til rette for helhetlig virksomhetsstyring. Du får også en sentral rolle i styringsdialogen med Nærings- og fiskeridepartementet (NFD).



Arbeidsoppgaver

Som avdelingsdirektør får du blant annet ansvar for å:

  • utvikle lederne og medarbeiderne i avdelingen, bidra til sterke og utviklingsorienterte fagmiljøer og et godt arbeidsmiljø, og sikre godt samarbeid med tillitsvalgte
  • rapportere internt og til Patentstyrets eierdepartement, NFD

Som medlem av ledergruppen bidrar du aktivt i strategiske diskusjoner og prioriteringer. Du er med på å videreutvikle ledergruppen som team. I tillegg får du en viktig rolle i å styrke organisasjonens utviklings- og ledelseskapasitet, samarbeid og gjennomføringskraft.

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå.
  • Minst 5 års ledererfaring fra kunnskapsintensiv virksomhet i offentlig sektor. Det er ønskelig at du også har erfaring fra næringslivet.
  • Bred erfaring med virksomhetsstyring på både strategisk og operativt nivå.
  • God forståelse for økonomifaget.
  • Erfaring med strategisk styring, analyse, og gjennomføring av gode beslutningsprosesser.

  • God evne til å uttrykke deg muntlig og skriftlig på norsk og engelsk.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter en trygg leder som løfter blikket, ser de lange linjene og skaper struktur, retning, samarbeid og fremdrift. Du lykkes godt i rollen hvis du:

  • Skaper felles forståelse for oppdraget, ambisjonene og de strategiske føringene, og omsetter dem til konkrete planer, leveranser og effekt.

jobs.title: Warehouse worker - 2-shift system - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Loading and unloading trucks
  • Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
  • Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

  • Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
  • Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
  • Can work in a 2-shift system
  • Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
  • Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

  • Already live in Belgium
  • Have a valid Belgian address
  • Have legal permission to work in Belgium

Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

Beantwoorden van inkomende telefoongesprekken van klanten (ongeveer 50% van je tijd, gemiddeld 40 oproepen per dag).

Voor ons zijn motivatie, klantgerichtheid en teamspirit belangrijker dan jaren ervaring.

Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Frans (tweetalig NL/FR of FR/NL).

Een eerste ervaring in customer service, een callcenter of een andere klantgerichte functie.
Ervaring binnen de logistieke sector is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
jobs.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Universitetet i Oslo søker  studentkoordinator
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Har du gode minner fra din første tid som student ved Universitetet i Oslo? Har du lyst til å skape morsomme og minneverdige opplevelser for søkere og nye studenter? Vi søker en engasjert student til å planlegge og gjennomføre arrangementer for avgangselever i videregående skole og nye studenter i studiestart.

Universitetet i Oslo har to studentkoordinatorer hvert år. Siden vår ene studentkoordinator skal fortsette, skal vi ansette én ny i år.

Studentkoordinator er en stilling med stor grad av kreativ frihet og ansvar, og den er todelt.

  • Faddersjefkoordinator. Som faddersjefkoordinator har man overordna ansvar for fadderordninga ved Universitetet i Oslo og jobber med planlegging og gjennomføring av studiestartsuka i januar (11-15. januar) og august (16.-20. august). Dette innebærer ledelse av universitetets faddersjefnettverk, utvikling av store studiestartsarrangementer og arbeid med fadderopplæring og -goder.

 

  • Turnéleder i Universitetsturneen som gjennomføres på videregående skoler vinteren 2026. Turnelederne fullfører planleggingen av turneen i Oslo og omegn, organiserer turnehverdagen, leder turnegruppa og har ansvar for gjennomføring. Dette innebærer å holde presentasjoner om utdanningsvalg, sikre at arrangementene blir gjennomført som planlagt, skape fellesskap og samarbeid mellom studentambassadørene fra de ulike universitetene og skrive evaluering av turneen i etterkant. I forbindelse med gjennomføringa må det regnes med rundt to eller tre uker fulltidsjobb i januar/februar, hvorav en uke er på reise utenfor Oslo.

Begge studentkoordinatorene skal jobbe med begge deler av stillinga, og det stilles krav til gode samarbeidsevner. Du vil jobbe tett med den andre studentkoordinatoren, men også med faddersjefer, studentambassadører og ansatte i UiOs kommunikasjonsavdeling.

Utenom arrangementene ligger arbeidsmengden på en eller to dager i uka (omtrent 20-40%) etter avtale, og egner seg godt til å kombinere med studiene. I forbindelse med planleggingsinnspurt og gjennomføring av arrangementene må man imidlertid regne med høyt arbeidstrykk. Dette gjelder desember januar, februar og august. Vi legger til rette for fleksibel arbeidstid i forbindelse med eksamen og andre obligatoriske undervisningsaktiviteter.

Stillingens varighet er fra rundt 10. oktober 2026 til 1. oktober 2027


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil i hovedsak være 
  • Planlegge, videreutvikle og gjennomføre UiOs skolebesøksturné i januar og februar 2027
  • Planlegge, videreutvikle og gjennomføre UiOs studiestartsarrangementer i januar og august 2027
  • Bidra til å utvikle og skape tekst og videoinnhold rettet mot studenter og faddere.
  • Legge års- og aktivitetsplan og lede faddersjefnettverket og gi støtte til faddersjefene på fakultetene
  • Bidra inn i arbeidet med å tilpasse og utvikle fadderkurs
  • Representere fadderne ved UiO overfor UiOs ledelse, i media og samarbeid med andre institusjoner

Vi ser etter deg som 
  • Ivrer for at UiO-søkere skal ta et informert studievalg
  • Engasjeres av at UiOs studenter får en god start på studiene
  • Liker formidling, har gode formidlingsevner, -  og ønsker å bli enda bedre
  • Samarbeider godt med andre og er flink til å motivere og lede
  • Er kreativ og idérik
  • Er ansvarlig
  • Jobber strukturert, jevnt og trutt

Vi trenger ulike perspektiver i vårt arbeid 

UiO er et åpent og internasjonalt breddeuniversitet, og vil være en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass og studiested. Les mer om UiOs arbeid for likestilling, inkludering og mangfold på uio.no.

Vi løser vårt samfunnsoppdrag best når vi tar i bruk våre ulike erfaringer, bakgrunner og perspektiver. Vi vil gjerne ha flere gode kolleger – kanskje den neste er deg?  

Vi vil tilrettelegge dersom du har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være endring av arbeidstid, tilpasning av arbeidsoppgaver, digital, teknisk, eller fysisk tilrettelegging eller andre praktiske tilpasninger.

Har du innvandrerbakgrunn, funksjonsnedsettelse eller hull i CV-en, oppfordrer vi deg til å krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert søker fra hver gruppe til intervju. Med funksjonsnedsettelse menes her en søker som oppgir å ha en funksjonsnedsettelse som vil medføre tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen eller i arbeidsforholdet. Les mer om kravene på Arbeidsgiverportalen.

Avkrysningene i jobbsøkerportalen blir brukt til anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter.

Vi håper at du søker på stillingen hos oss. 


Vi kan tilby deg
  • Meningsfulle oppgaver med kreativt handlingsrom
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Et sosialt og støttende arbeidsmiljø hos studentambassadørene og UiOs kommunikasjonsavdeling
  • God opplæring innenfor UiOs organisasjon samt formidlingsteknikk og mediehåndtering
  • Fast kontorplass på flermannskontor og jobb-laptop
  • Timelønn på 238 kr/timen.

Søknad

Søknaden skal inneholde:

  • NB! Det er veldig viktig at de blir lastet opp et Søknadsbrev, da dette ved en feil ble deaktivert før publisering. 
  • CV
  • Vitnemål og attester
  • Kontaktinformasjon til 2-3 referanser

Din CV må registreres i Jobbnorges CV-skjema, og kan ikke kun legges ved som vedlegg. Ordningen skal sikre korrekt dokumentasjon og journalføring i tråd med forskrift til forvaltningsloven § 15.

Søknad med vedlegg må sendes inn via vårt rekrutteringssystem Jobbnorge, klikk “Søk stillingen”.

Når du søker på stillingen, ber vi deg hente utdanningsresultatene dine fra Vitnemålsportalen.no. Om utdanningsresultatene dine ikke er tilgjengelige via Vitnemålsportalen, ber vi deg laste opp kopier av vitnemålene eller karakterutskriftene dine. All dokumentasjon må være på engelsk eller et skandinavisk språk.


Generell informasjon

Vennligst merk at vi ikke kan legge til dokumentasjon etter søknadsfristen. Ettersom fristen er lik for alle søkere, skal denne praksisen sikre likebehandling gjennom hele rekrutteringsprosessen. Hvis du opplever problemer med å laste opp dokumenter i Jobbnorge, ber vi deg kontakte deres kundeservice. 

Den primære kommunikasjonsformen gjennom prosessen vil være e-poster og meldinger via Jobbnorge. Når du mottar varsel om en melding i Jobbnorge, ber vi deg logge inn for å lese den, da den kan inneholde viktig informasjon.

Aktuelle søkerne vil bli invitert til intervju.

Søkerlister kan bli offentliggjort iht. Offentleglova § 25 andre ledd. Når du søker jobb hos oss vil navnet ditt stå på den offentlige søkerlisten. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne listen. Du må begrunne hvorfor du ønsker unntak fra offentliggjøring og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det vil du høre fra oss.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Oslo er Norges eldste og høyest rangerte forsknings- og utdanningsinstitusjon med 26 500 studenter og 7 200 ansatte. Faglig bredde og internasjonalt anerkjente forskningsmiljøer gjør UiO til en viktig samfunnsaktør.

Seksjon for samfunnskontakt er underlagt Avdeling for kommunikasjon og samfunnskontakt. Avdeling for kommunikasjon og samfunnskontakt har et overordnet ansvar for strategisk og operativ kommunikasjon ved UiO. Avdelingen leder kommunikasjonsområdet sentralt på universitetet med ansvar for visjon, strategi, planlegging, tjenesteportefølje og kanaler samt utvikling av disse. Hovedoppgavene er bl.a. mediehåndtering, samspill med myndigheter, utvikle relasjonen og kommunikasjonen mellom UiO og omverdenen, koordinere og utvikle UiOs sentrale kommunikasjonskanaler- og oppgaver.

jobs.title: Kids - Fashion Designer - H&M Regional Relevance
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re looking for an experienced Fashion Designer to join our Kids Regional Assortment team and help shape trend-driven collections that connect global vision with local relevance. Based at our Stockholm Head Office, this exciting role focuses on our Equatorial markets — translating global fashion direction into culturally resonant, climate-smart designs and commercially impactful assortments for warm-weather regions.

As a Designer within Regional Relevance, you’ll create inspiring, market-tailored collections that speak directly to diverse customers while staying true to the global brand identity. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across Stockholm and regional markets, you’ll help bring extended visual concepts to life, enriching the main collection and elevating regional storytelling through compelling design.

Working alongside the Regional Relevance Team Lead and the wider Design team, you’ll co-create concept-led assortments that balance a broad commercial offering with standout fashion moments, exclusive drops, and locally inspired campaigns. The role also offers exciting opportunities for international collaboration and travel — from global inspiration trips to hands-on supplier engagement — giving you the chance to influence fashion on a truly international scale.

Please note: This is a 12-month temporary contract to start.

Who You’ll Work With

You will be part of a dynamic, multidisciplinary team of Designers, Product Developers, Planners, Pattern Makers, and a Team Lead.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, combining a distinctive creative perspective with strong commercial awareness. A solid understanding of global fashion trends, paired with sensitivity to local market needs, will be essential.

Strong organizational and communication skills are key, as well as the ability to structure your work effectively, align stakeholders, and clearly bring your vision forward.

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented and fashion-driven designer with a clear point of view and a strong understanding of the global kidswear landscape. You combine creativity with commercial thinking and bring both vision and structure to your work.

We are looking for someone with:

- A BA/MA in Fashion or Textile Design, or equivalent experience

- Several years of experience in a design role

- Experience within a global fashion brand (experience with equatorial markets is a strong plus)

- A strong background in kids design, with attention to detail

- A sharp eye for emerging trends and how to translate them into product

- Strong collaboration and communication skills

- Proven ability to work in a structured way, managing timelines and multiple priorities

- Experience working with suppliers and factories across Asia and Europe

- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (experience with AI tools is a plus)

- A proactive mindset and ability to drive ideas forward

- Fluency in English



Please note our Designers are based in our HQ in Stockholm, Sweden. If you are not already based here we would need you to be able to relocate as part of a requirement for these roles. We have a dedicated relocation team to make this as smooth as possible.  

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP.

For more information and a chance to be considered for current and future opportunities please apply with your latest CV and Portfolio (in English). A member of our Recruitment team will be in touch if we feel you are a great match.

jobs.title: Senior Trade Marketing Lead

jobs.description:
Har du en passion för både försäljning och service och drivs av att skapa nya möjligheter hos tidigare kunder? Då kan rollen som Customer Sales Advisor vara helt rätt för dig!

Om tjänsten I takt med Synsams fortsatta tillväxt och ökade satsning inom Loyalty utökar vi nu teamet med ytterligare en Customer Sales Advisor . I denna strategiskt viktiga och långsiktiga roll får du chansen att stärka våra kundrelationer, skapa nya affärsmöjligheter och bidra till Synsams fortsatta framgång.  Du kommer att spela en nyckelroll i vår strävan att hitta nya lösningar för kunder och samtidigt säkerställa högsta möjliga kundnöjdhet.

Tjänsten är placerad på vårt toppmoderna Synsam Innovation Center på Frösön i Östersund, där du blir en del av en dynamisk och framåttänkande organisation.  Vi välkomnar både svensktalande och norsktalande medarbetare för att möta våra kunders behov på båda marknaderna.

Dina ansvarsområden

    

Kontakta tidigare kunder på telefon för att lyssna in och förstå deras behov och förväntningar.

    

Identifiera och erbjuda skräddarsydda lösningar som möter kundens krav.

    

Återuppbygga relationer och stärka kundens förtroende för Synsam.

    

Arbeta aktivt för att överträffa uppsatta mål inom både försäljning och kundnöjdhet.

    

Dokumentera och följa upp alla samtal för att säkerställa en sömlös kundupplevelse.

Är det dig vi söker?  Vi letar efter en driven och engagerad person som brinner för att skapa framgångsrika kundrelationer. Vi tror att du:

    

Är en naturlig kommunikatör med förmågan att lyssna in och sätta dig in i kundens behov och perspektiv.

    

Flytande i svenska eller norska, både i tal och skrift – du vet hur man skapar förtroende med ord. Har du erfarenhet av andra nordiska språk är det meriterande, men ej krav.

    

Har tidigare erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med uppsökande försäljning med förmåga att bygga relationer, vinna kundernas förtroende och leverera resultat.

    

Resultatinriktad och älskar att sätta upp mål – och överträffa dem!

    

En person med en positiv attityd och en förmåga att se lösningar där andra ser hinder.

Vi erbjuder  Hos oss får du chansen att kliva in i en nyckelroll i vår spännande, nystartade satsning på att stärka och återvinna kundrelationer. Detta är din möjlighet att bidra till Synsams framgångssaga samtidigt som du utvecklas i en inspirerande och dynamisk arbetsmiljö på vårt toppmoderna Synsam Innovation Center, beläget på vackra Frösön i Östersund.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid (måndag-fredag) som inleds med en provanställning.  Du blir en del av ett engagerat team och får löpande utbildning samt utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och kundnöjdhet. Dessutom erbjuder vi en attraktiv ersättningsmodell som kombinerar en trygg fast lön med en prestationsbaserad bonus.

Om rekryteringsprocessen  I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat.  Urval sker löpande och intervjuer kommer att hållas i augusti - men sök gärna redan idag!🚀 Vi på Synsam söker engagerade och talangfulla personer i alla åldrar! Hos oss värdesätts mångfald och vi tror att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter berikar vårt arbete och bidrar till vår gemensamma framgång.  Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team på Frösön! 🌟

jobs.title: Enhetschef hav, vatten och odlingslandskap till Naturskyddsföreningen
jobs.description:
Vill du leda arbetet för levande hav, friska vatten och ett hållbart jordbruk i ett rikt odlingslandskap? Naturskyddsföreningen söker en enhetschef som vill driva och utveckla vårt arbete inom hav, vatten och odlingslandskap, områden som är avgörande för att stoppa förlusten av biologisk mångfald och bidra till en hållbar användning av våra naturresurser. Arbetet sker i nära samspel med politik, forskning och civilsamhälle. Läs mer och ansök senast 20 september!

Rollen som Enhetschef hav, vatten och odlingslandskap

Enheten för hav, vatten och odlingslandskap är en del av avdelningen för Biologisk mångfald och miljögifter och består av medarbetare med hög kompetens och stort engagemang. Tillsammans driver ni frågor som rör bland annat hållbart fiske, skydd och restaurering av marina och limniska miljöer samt omställningen till ett mer hållbart jordbruk och ett robust livsmedelssystem.

Som enhetschef har du ett helhetsansvar för enhetens verksamhet, med fokus på att leda, utveckla och prioritera arbetet så att det får största möjliga genomslag. Du kombinerar strategiskt arbete med operativt ledarskap och skapar goda förutsättningar för medarbetarna att bidra med sin kompetens. Du leder i en miljö med många parallella och komplexa frågor, vilket ställer krav på förmåga att skapa struktur, riktning och långsiktighet i arbetet.

I rollen ingår många externa kontakter där du representerar Naturskyddsföreningen gentemot myndigheter, forskare, organisationer och beslutsfattare. Du samarbetar nära med övriga enheter inom avdelningen och andra delar av organisationen, och bidrar till helhetsperspektiv och gemensamma strategiska prioriteringar.

För att matcha kraven rollen ställer på dig, ser vi gärna att du har: 

    

akademisk utbildning

    

chefserfarenhet och erfarenhet av att leda i förändring

    

god kunskap om frågor som rör hav, vatten och/eller jordbruk, gärna med ett systemperspektiv

    

erfarenhet av politiskt påverkansarbete

    

erfarenhet av att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt

    

mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för att du ska trivas hos oss. Därför förväntar vi oss att du: 

    

är en trygg ledare som kan entusiasmera, coacha och hjälpa medarbetare att prioritera

    

har god samarbetsförmåga, är lyhörd, relationsskapande och prestigelös, trivs i en komplex organisation med många kontaktytor

    

är strukturerad och initiativtagande, med god förmåga att prioritera

    

är mål- och resultatinriktad, i dina prioriteringar, planering och agerande

    

är strategisk, analytisk och med stark kommunikativ förmåga

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 20 september. Urvalet sker löpande.

Om Naturskyddsföreningen 

Naturskyddsföreningen är Sveriges största miljöorganisation och en folkrörelse som sedan 1909 står upp för naturen. Vi sprider kunskap, bildar opinion och påverkar beslutsfattare – lokalt, nationellt och globalt. Klimat, skog, jordbruk, miljögifter, vatten, hav och hållbar konsumtion är våra viktigaste arbetsområden. Bra Miljöval är vår miljömärkning och Sveriges Natur vår medlemstidning. Tillsammans har vi kraft att förändra. 

Naturskyddsföreningen vill vara en inkluderande folkrörelse som speglar samhället, och vi vill att det ska genomsyra hela vår verksamhet. Vi vill vara en arbetsplats som är attraktiv för alla, eftersom vi tror att en variation av perspektiv, erfarenheter och bakgrund gör oss ännu starkare. Vi arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering. 

Övrigt 

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Tillträde snarast möjligt enligt överenskommelse. Naturskyddsföreningen tillämpar provanställning.

Frågor

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg.  

Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta: 

Joanna Widstrand, HR-specialist, 076 188 50 24, joanna.widstrand@naturskyddsforeningen.se

Anders Mankler, Avdelningschef Biologisk mångfald och miljögifter, 073 522 09 45, anders.mankler@naturskyddsforeningen.se

jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med relationer som möjliggör verklig förändring – på lång sikt?

Naturskyddsföreningen söker nu en ansvarig för filantropi och stora gåvogivare med uppdrag att vidareutveckla och driva vårt arbete med större gåvor, filantropiska relationer och privata stiftelser.

Vi söker dig som vill ha en självständig nyckelroll. Det här är en strategisk och relationsnära roll för dig som vill kombinera prospektering, långsiktigt relationsbyggande och professionell struktur – i en miljöorganisation med fokus i Sverige med internationell förankring.

Om rollen som projektledare Filantropi

Som ansvarig för filantropi och stora gåvogivare utvecklar och driver du Naturskyddsföreningens arbete med filantropi, större privata gåvor och privata stiftelser. Målet är att bygga långsiktiga relationer som stärker finansieringen av vår verksamhet och skapar förutsättningar för ett ökat engagemang och ett hållbart givande.

Rollen kombinerar strategiskt utvecklingsarbete med operativt relationsbyggande där du identifierar, utvecklar och förvaltar relationer med filantroper, större givare och privata stiftelser. Du driver dialoger, planerar och genomför nätverksträffar, möten och andra aktiviteter samt utvecklar erbjudanden och samarbeten som stärker relationerna och bidrar till organisationens långsiktiga intäktsutveckling. Du säkerställer att relationerna förvaltas med hög kvalitet genom hela givarresan och att filantropiarbetet bedrivs i linje med Naturskyddsföreningens värderingar och etiska riktlinjer.

Tjänsten är placerad på enheten Strategisk finansiering inom Marknadsavdelningen. Du rapporterar till enhetschef för Strategisk finansiering och samarbetar nära kollegor inom insamling, kommunikation och verksamheten i stort, samt med externa rådgivare och samarbetspartners. Vi befinner oss i en utvecklingsfas där vi stärker vårt arbete med filantropi och implementerar Salesforce som ett centralt verktyg för att skapa ett mer strukturerat, datadrivet och relationsorienterat arbetssätt.

För att matcha kraven rollen ställer på dig ser vi att du har:

    

erfarenhet av arbete med filantropi, större givare, stiftelser eller annan relationsbaserad finansiering eller insamling från t.ex. akademin, ideell eller privat sektor

    

dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva komplexa samarbeten, affärer eller givarrelationer som genererat betydande intäkter

    

ett väl upparbetat nätverk

    

erfarenhet av att arbeta med CRM-system som stöd för relationshantering och uppföljning

    

god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Utöver detta är det meriterande om du har:

    

erfarenhet från ideell sektor

    

erfarenhet av att utforma, förhandla och slutföra avtal

    

erfarenhet av att utveckla och paketera värdeskapande samarbeten

    

erfarenhet av att arbeta i en beställarroll gentemot byrå eller extern leverantör

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för att du ska trivas hos oss. Därför förväntar vi oss att du:

    

är relationsskapande med mycket god förmåga att bygga förtroendefulla relationer

    

är lyhörd och kan kommunicera på ett sätt anpassat efter mottagare

    

har ett utvecklat självledarskap som präglar ditt sätt att planera, genomföra och följa upp ditt arbete

    

kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med ett strukturerat och resultatorienterat arbetssätt

    

har ett gott omdöme och hög integritet i ditt arbete med givare och samarbetspartners

Vi lägger särskilt stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper i denna rekrytering.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 27 september!

Om Naturskyddsföreningen 

Naturskyddsföreningen är Sveriges största miljöorganisation och en folkrörelse som sedan 1909 står upp för naturen. Vi sprider kunskap, bildar opinion och påverkar beslutsfattare – lokalt, nationellt och globalt. Klimat, skog, jordbruk, miljögifter, vatten, hav och hållbar konsumtion är våra viktigaste arbetsområden. Bra Miljöval är vår miljömärkning och Sveriges Natur vår medlemstidning. Tillsammans har vi kraft att förändra. 

Naturskyddsföreningen vill vara en inkluderande folkrörelse som speglar samhället, och vi vill att det ska genomsyra hela vår verksamhet. Vi vill vara en arbetsplats som är attraktiv för alla, eftersom vi tror att en variation av perspektiv, erfarenheter och bakgrund gör oss ännu starkare. Vi arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.

Övrigt 

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Tillträde snarast enligt överenskommelse. Naturskyddsföreningen tillämpar provanställning.

Frågor

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
tappz is looking for a Marketing Intern to join our small, but highly productive and ambitious team in Berlin or Munich — with the option to grow into a permanent junior role afterwards. You'll get hands-on experience in a highly specialized corner of marketing that you simply can't learn in school: growth marketing for apps.

We build apps with global reach, and cutting-edge AI. In this role you can expect hands-on training across App Store, funnels, and web marketing — working directly with all team members, with access to the same AI tools we use every day. We need someone who's proactive, curious about trends, and hungry to be at the edge of what's next in marketing.

Tasks

App Store Optimization & AI Engine Optimization

  • Market and competitor analysis to improve how our apps are discovered — in app stores and by AI assistants.
  • Help optimize app store listings — copy, screenshots, and metadata — and monitor rankings and reviews.

Funnels & Web

  • Help build and test web-to-app and web-to-web funnels, from landing page to conversion.
  • Maintain and update our marketing web pages, working with design and dev as needed.

Market Research & Insights

  • Monitor niche trends and innovations, generate ideas for in-app content.
  • Manage localizations and culturalizations, both for app and web listings.

Team support

  • Be the team's go-to helper — pitching in wherever needed and learning the full scope of mobile and web marketing along the way.
  • Help build automated processes with the AI tools we provide, to work faster and smarter across all of the above.

Requirements

We are looking for

  • A proactive approach — you spot what needs doing and get started.
  • Self-motivation and a genuine desire to be at the edge of technology.
  • Curiosity about marketing trends, with the drive to keep learning and improving.
  • Comfort working in a small, fast-moving, collaborative team, and juggling a few different areas at once.
  • Good proficiency in English, since you'll be writing copy for a global audience.
  • A formal background in mobile/web marketing is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

  • Exciting opportunities to work on AI products.
  • A collaborative, supportive work environment with direct mentorship.
  • Professional development and training in a highly specialized, in-demand field, with a clear path to grow from junior into a specialist or growth-marketing role.
  • Hands-on access to the same AI and marketing tools our team uses day to day.
  • Remote work, with covered co-working space.

Send us your CV along with a short Cover Letter — 300 words is plenty — that tells us:

  1. Why you're excited about mobile and web marketing.
  2. One app, brand, or campaign you've been obsessed with lately, and why.
  3. A project you've run yourself — a side hustle, student organization, social media account, blog, game community, or anything else where you had to attract or grow an audience. Links welcome.

tappz is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)

Das bieten wir dir

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer  (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) who can take ownership of complex mechanical designs from concept through detailed engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and validation.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, extensive practical design experience, and advanced SolidWorks capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of complex mechanical components, assemblies, and subsystems from concept through manufacturing, assembly, and validation

  • Develop robust mechanical designs for high-precision scientific and industrial equipment

  • Create and maintain high-quality SolidWorks parts, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation

  • Perform tolerance analysis and define appropriate fits, interfaces, geometric tolerances, and dimensional requirements

  • Translate system-level requirements into clear mechanical requirements, interfaces, and manufacturable design solutions

  • Define manufacturing requirements and work closely with suppliers and Procurement on manufacturability, materials, tolerances, and quality

  • Develop, test, and improve prototypes and actively contribute to design reviews and technical decision-making


Required skills:

  • BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Precision Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • Minimum 8 years of professional mechanical engineering experience

  • Advanced professional proficiency in SolidWorks is mandatory

  • Demonstrable experience designing complex mechanical assemblies, bespoke machinery, or technically demanding systems

  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, including manufacturing methods, materials, tolerance analysis, GD&T, DfM/DfA, structural design, and mechanical interface

  • Strong ownership of mechanical designs and technical decisions

We value:

  • CSWP – Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional certification

  • Experience in industries such as scientific instrumentation, semiconductor equipment, aerospace, precision engineering, special-purpose machinery, optics, or similar fields

  • Experience with high-precision systems and/or exposure to vacuum, cryogenic, thermal, optical, or vibration-sensitive applications

  • Excellent engineering judgment and the ability to identify and improve weak or risky design solutions

  • Practical understanding of how components are manufactured, assembled, tested, and serviced

 What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding particular achievements.

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules.

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development.

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being.

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus.

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications.

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices, and meeting rooms.

jobs.title: Vi hjälper dig att bli nästa Kyltekniker!
jobs.description:
Indoor är ett teknikföretag som har funnits sedan 1990. Företaget kombinerar hög teknisk kompetens med lokal närvaro och långsiktiga kundrelationer. Med fokus på kvalitet, hållbarhet och energieffektivisering hjälper Indoor sina kunder att skapa drift- och energieffektiva anläggningar. Verksamheten bygger på värderingarna lagspel, engagemang och ägarskap, och ambitionen att vara en långsiktig och engagerad partner till sina kunder.

Är du redo att ta steget in i framtidens industri? PNs samarbete med Indoor ger dig både teoretisk kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet för att kickstarta din karriär som Kyltekniker. Efter 12 introduktionsveckor som innehåller onboarding och handledning påbörjar du ditt uppdrag hos Indoor i en bransch där efterfrågan på kompetens bara växer.  

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord lanserar nu återigen för andra gången detta framgångsrika upplägg i samarbete med Satellite Group. Via vår satsning formar vi nästa generations Kyltekniker. Under introduktionsperioden via Satellite Group utvecklar du färdigheter så att du snabbt blir trygg i arbetsuppgifterna som krävs i rollen som Kyltekniker.

Du kommer sedan att bli antälld via Professionals Nord och arbeta som konsult hos Indoor under minst 18 månader. Målet är sedan att din anställning går över till Indoor, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet.

Vi vet av erfarenhet att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för din framgång. Därför välkomnar vi dig, oavsett tidigare kunskap eller bakgrund, att bli Indoors nästa Kyltekniker!

Information om introduktionsperioden

Introduktionsperioden bygger på metoden Accelerated Learning, där kortare teoretiska delar kombineras med praktiska moment för att ge dig alla verktyg du behöver för att lyckas i rollen. Under perioden utvecklas du inom områden som:

    Kylteknik
    Ellära
    Rörsystem och systemuppbyggnad
    Köldmedier och F-gas förordningen
    Kylcertifikat kategori 1



Vi erbjuder möjlighet till studiestöd under hela introduktionsperioden.

Uppstartsevent: 21 september

Introduktion: 21 september – 22 januari (detaljer för hela introduktionsperioden får du på anställningsintervjun)

Första dag hos Indoor: 25 januari

Omfattning: Heltid

Plats: Linköping + distans

Arbetsort efter avslutad satsning: Stockholm

Om Indoor:

Indoor är ett teknikföretag som hjälper sina kunder att skapa mer energieffektiva fastigheter genom tjänster inom kyla, värme, ventilation samt styr- och reglerteknik. Företaget har funnits sedan 1990, har cirka 200 medarbetare och servar över 10 000 fastigheter runt om i Sverige. Med bred teknisk kompetens och lokal närvaro arbetar Indoor utifrån visionen att skapa Sveriges mest energieffektiva fastigheter.

Information om tjänsten

Som Kyltekniker hos Indoor Stockholm blir du en del av serviceavdelningen som består av 20 teknikers. I rollen kommer du att ha mycket kontakt med kunder och arbeta med det mesta inom kyla, allt från underhåll, service och ombyggnationer till utredningar, felsökningar och åtgärdsförslag på kundernas olika anläggningar. Varje åtagande varierar i omfattning och du kommer arbeta i många olika typer av miljöer, exempelvis mindre restaurangkök till stora industrier eller fastighetsbolag. I tjänsten ingår även mycket dokumentation och rapportering i system.  

Du ansvarar för dina egna kunder och får stor frihet i rollen samtidigt som du har nära stöd från kunniga kollegor med bred kompetens inom olika områden. För att ge dig rätt förutsättningar i rollen kommer du initialt att arbeta nära en erfaren kollega för att successivt lära känna organisationen, kunderna och de olika typer av anläggningar ni arbetar med. Du får tillgång till bil och kommer själv åka ut till dina kunder på jobb när du har kommit in i rollen.

Vi söker dig som

    Fyllt 18 år eller är äldre
    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
    Stort intresse för att göra ett karriärbyte till Kyltekniker
    Innehar B-körkort
    Har godkända tester (MAP & Matrigma)
    

Godkänd bakgrundskontroll

Vi tror att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för hur väl du kommer trivas under introduktionsperioden och i som Kyltekniker hos Indoor. Du arbetar noggrant med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och precision. För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är social, prestigelös och har lätt för att samarbeta med kollegor, kunder och andra yrkesgrupper, samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt. Vi ser gärna att du vill utvecklas långsiktigt, lära dig nya moment och ta ansvar för din egen utveckling. Med rätt driv finns goda möjligheter att växa vidare inom Indoor.

I din ansökan vill vi därför att du bifogar ditt CV men även ett personligt brev där det framgår varför du är intresserad av just denna satsning och arbetet som Kyltekniker.

Efter inskickad ansökan kommer du att få ett mail med länk till en personlighetstest och ett test kopplat till logisk slutledningsförmåga som du behöver genomföra med godkänt resultat för att gå vidare i rekryteringsprocessen.
