In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Employer: T & M Ventures Ltd, trading as The Burton Location: The Burton, 18/19 Duke Street, Dublin Position: Sous Chef Employment: Full-time Hours: 20 hours per week Salary: €41,600 equivalent to approximately €20 per hour based on a 40-hour working week, depending on experience. T & M Ventures Ltd, trading as The Burton, is seeking an experienced and motivated Sous Chef to join our professional kitchen team at The Burton, 18/19 Duke Street, Dublin. The successful candidate will assist the Head Chef in the day-to-day management and operation of the kitchen and will help ensure consistently high standards of international food preparation, presentation, food safety and kitchen organization. Main Duties and Responsibilities Assist the Head Chef with the daily management and operation of the kitchen. Supervise and coordinate kitchen staff during food preparation and service. Support the Head Chef in maintaining consistent food quality, presentation and portion control. Prepare, cook and present dishes to the required standards. Oversee food preparation and service across different sections of the kitchen as required. Assist with menu planning, development of dishes and implementation of seasonal menu changes. Ensure that all food is prepared and stored in accordance with food safety, HACCP and hygiene requirements. Monitor stock levels and assist with ordering, receiving and proper storage of ingredients and supplies. Assist with stock control, waste reduction and effective management of food costs. Train, support and supervise junior chefs and other kitchen personnel. Organise kitchen workflow and allocate duties to kitchen staff during preparation and service. Ensure kitchen equipment, work areas and food preparation areas are maintained to appropriate hygiene and safety standards. Assist in maintaining kitchen records and food safety documentation. Work closely with the Head Chef and management team to ensure the efficient operation of the kitchen. Deputise for the Head Chef when required. Ensure compliance with health and safety procedures and all applicable food hygiene regulations. Requirements Minimum of 5 years' professional experience at Sous Chef level (International cuisine). Strong knowledge of professional kitchen operations, food preparation and cooking techniques. Good knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene and food safety procedures. Experience supervising and coordinating kitchen staff. Ability to work effectively in a busy professional kitchen environment. Strong organizational and communication skills. Ability to maintain high standards of food quality and presentation. Ability to work as part of a team and support the Head Chef in the overall management of the kitchen. apply here

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F) (3 postes)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

jobs.title: Kokoonpanija tuotantoon
jobs.description:
Kokoonpanija tuotantoon

Etsimme arvostetulle teollisuusalan asiakkaallemme mekaanista asentajaa kokoonpanotehtäviin tuotantoon.

Asiakkaamme suunnittelee ja valmistaa omia suunnittelemiaan tuotteita eri laitevalmistajille teollisuuden tarpeisiin. Toimintaa ohjaa korkea laatu, vahva osaaminen ja pitkä kokemus alalta.

Tehtävässäsi

Pääset työskentelemään kokoonpano tiimissä tehden itsenäisesti monipuolista mekaanista osakokoonpanoa. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti kättesi jäljen sekä osallistumaan laadukkaiden tuotteiden valmistukseen alusta loppuun.

Työsi sisältää mm.:

- mekaanista asennus- ja kokoonpanotyötä

- teknisten piirustusten lukemista ja hyödyntämistä

- vianetsintää ja ongelmanratkaisua tuotannon eri vaiheissa, ennenkuin tuote lähtee ulos

- yhteistyötä kokeneen tiimin kanssa

Odotamme sinulta

Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta
Aikaisempaa kokemusta sarjatuotannon kokoonpanoista tai mekaanisista asennustyö kokemusta teollisuusympäristössä
Hyvää piirustusten lukutaitoa
Ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti, että osana tiimiä

Eduksi katsomme:

- erilaisten käsityökalujen käyttötaidot

- kokemuksen mekaanisesta asentamisesta ja kappaleiden käsittelystä

- ERP-järjestelmän käyttökokemusta

Tarjoamme sinulle

Vakaan ja arvostetun työnantajan
Modernit työvälineet ja siistin työympäristön
Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Vaihtelevan työn, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi

Työsuhde alkaa määräaikaisena, mutta tavoitteena on pitkäaikainen yhteistyö. Työ on kokopäivätyötä arkisin, ja sitä tehdään 1–2 vuorossa, joten valmius vuorotyöhön on tärkeää.

Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä – toimi siis nopeasti!

Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tietosuojasyistä.


Talent ValtaGroup

Talent ValtaGroup on rekrytointeihin ja henkilöstövuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, jonka toiminnassa yhdistyvät vahva asiantuntemus ja aito välittäminen. Uskomme, että onnistunut rekrytointi ei ole pelkkää osaajien ja yritysten yhdistämistä – se on ihmisten urapolkujen ja organisaatioiden menestyksen rakentamista.

Meillä rekrytointi tehdään tunteella ja taidolla. Kohtaamme sekä asiakkaat että ehdokkaat yksilöinä, kuunnellen ja ymmärtäen heidän tarpeensa. Toimimme avoimesti, joustavasti ja vastuullisesti varmistaen, että jokainen rekrytointiprosessi on sujuva ja ehdokaskokemus laadukas.

Pitkä kokemuksemme eri toimialojen rekrytoinneista ja henkilöstövuokrauksesta on tuonut meille kyvyn löytää juuri oikeat osaajat oikeisiin paikkoihin – tavalla, joka tuntuu oikealta.

Traditional Danish food, development opportunities, flexible working hours and fantastic colleagues – does this sound like your next job? Then you might be our new chef at NyhavnsKroen.

You must be a level headed, and strong teamplayer who is able to work effeciantly and navigate in a busy kitchen where timing is of the essens.

Our kitchen staff has a strong focus on ensuring that we all keep the highest standards in the kitchen in terms of quality, hygiene, and energy, and we therefore are expecting the same of you.   To make sure all the food we serve is living up to our high standards.

Ensure compliance with applicable health codes and regulations.

You will be part of a dedicated team under the leadership of our head chef.

 

We believe that food can bring people together – and we want to be among the best at it. 

 

We are looking forward to hear from you.

jobs.title: Hallintosihteeri
jobs.description:
**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä


**Arvostamme:**

- Kykyä kannatella samanaikaisesti useita lankoja

- Sujuvia tiimi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Positiivista otetta ja kehittämishalua


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Toimitusjohtaja Teemu Vanharanta, teemu.vanharanta@panchovilla.fi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen **rekry@panchovilla.fi** viimeistään **25.9.2026**. Toimi kuitenkin nopeasti, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajan puitteissa ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.title: Health, Safety & Working Environment Advisor
jobs.description:
Petrolink Support ser etter en erfaren rådgiver innen helse, sikkerhet og arbeidsmiljø for å sikre den daglige driften av Offshore Helseklinikk i samsvar med lover og forskrifter.

Lokasjon: Offshore

Rotasjon: 14/28


Arbeidsoppgaver

• Sikre daglig drift av Offshore Helseklinikk i samsvar med lover og forskrifter, inkl. vedlikeholde beholdning og kontroll av medisiner og medisinsk utstyr, samt utstyr knyttet til nødhospital og håndtering av smittsomme sykdommer og epidemier.

• Yte faglig helsehjelp og gjennomføre medisinske undersøkelser og behandling av pasienter i samarbeid med vaktlege

• Gjennomføre risikobaserte helseundersøkelser i henhold til oppsatt program

• Dokumentere alle testresultater i den ansattes medisinsk journal

• Gjennomføre medisinske undersøkelser for å sertifisere SAR-medlemmer og sikre dokumentasjon i henhold til prosedyrer

• Gjennomføre ukentlig trening og opplæring for førstehjelpsgruppen og lede gruppen ved medisinsk nødsituasjon

• Gi råd og implementere nødvendige kontrolltiltak ved utbrudd av smittsomme sykdommer eller epidemier, i samarbeid med fagansvarlig lege

• Sikre at alt medisinsk-teknisk utstyr vedlikeholdes og kalibreres i henhold til produsentens anbefalinger

• Gjennomføre regelmessig testing, dokumentering og rapportering av drikkevann (prøvetaking) for å verifisere vannkvalitet.

• Iverksette og lede regelmessige hygienerunder i henhold til plan

• Bidra til å beskytte arbeidstakere mot eksponering for helseskadelige arbeidsmiljøfaktorer
  Dette inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

- Identifikasjon av helserisikofaktorer på arbeidsplassen (fysiske, psykologiske, kjemiske, biologiske og ergonomiske faktorer)

- Delta og bidra i arbeidstillatelses-møter og Sikker jobbanalyse-møter for å gi råd om avbøtende tiltak i henhold til kontrollhierarki

- Oppfølging av gjennomføring av arbeidsoppgaver i felten gjennom jobobservasjoner og inspeksjoner

- Gi informasjon til offshore-mannskap (befolkninger) basert på risikovurdering og kartlegging av arbeidsmiljøet

- Gi råd og veiledning om håndtering av kjemikalier

• Ved påvisning av tegn og symptomer på mulig arbeidsrelatert sykdom eller skade, gjennomføre innledende intervju og undersøkelser

- Varsle og rapportere resultatene til bedriftshelsetjenesten i henhold til prosedyrer. Informere fagansvarlig lege

- I samsvar med forskrifter, oppdatere eksponeringsregister med nødvendige detaljer dersom personell er eksponert for helseskadelige stoffer og kjemikalier

- Videreformidle avvik i sikkerhets og arbeidsmiljørelaterte forhold til relevante fagpersoner i landorganisasjonen. Formidle råd og foreslåtte avbøtende tiltak til offshore ledergruppe

• Delta og bidra i oppsatte møter med fagpersonell på land

Kvalifikasjoner

• Offentlig Godkjent Sykepleier, helst med spesialutdanning innenfor anestesi, akuttmedisin eller intensivsykepleie

• Erfaring fra offshore aktivitet innen petroleumsindustrien (ikke fra maritim sektor)

• Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring klinisk erfaring, helst etter spesialutdannelse, men annen erfaring innen akuttmedisin eller prehospital tjeneste vil også vektlegges

• Erfaring fra arbeid knyttet il risikovurderinger og målinger innen arbeidsmiljø (støy, vibrasjoner, kjemisk, biologisk og psykososial ekponering)

• Kjennskap til arbeidsmiljølovgivning, HMS forskrifter og -standarder (spesielt NORSOK S-002, C-001 og C-002)

• Gode kommunikasjons -og samarbeidsegenskaper

• Flytende både skriftlig og muntlig i norsk og engelsk

Personlige egenskaper

• Entusiastisk og gode samarbeidsevner

• HMS, strukturert og resultatorientert holdning

• Opptre selvstendig og kunne styre egne aktiviteter

Vi tilbyr

• Ansettelse med konkurransedyktige betingelser 

• Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger

4033 Stavanger

Petrolink Support støtter drift av plattformer, havbunnsanlegg og flytende produksjonsenheter til havs, olje- og gassterminaler på land, raffinerier og prosessanlegg inkludert LNG-terminaler samt anlegg for kraftproduksjon og karbonfangst. jobs.title: Production Manager to Beyond Gravity Linköping
jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​



About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com



Your Crew



Our production team at our brand-new factory in Linköping currently consists of around 100 dedicated people. We come from different backgrounds, which allows us to complement each other and benefit from each other’s experiences. Here, we are a team that enjoys taking initiative and solving problems together. Since we are still building up our production, we have great opportunities to influence and improve the way we work – perfect for those who like to be involved and make an impact from the start! We have an open and inclusive work environment, where all ideas are welcomed and utilized as we build the future of space production together.



Your Mission



    Leads a production team
    Responsible for the execution of the following activities:
    Assembly Execution (Manufacturing, Assembly and Integration and Testing)
    

    Composite and Bonding (AFP, Autoclave, NDI)
    Leads and directs the Assembly team of the plant through efficiency in:
    Manufacturing Execution  
    

    Ensuring the project production budgets
    

    Shopfloor-Management and define the production standards
    

    Productivity improvement initiatives
    

    CAPEX planning in line with new product introductions
    Execution of the shop orders within the framework of the specified quantity, quality, delivery dates and costs
    

    Cooperation with the quality assurance / product assurance ensuring the necessary production documentation
    

    Optimize manufacturing processes in terms of cost, quality, defect risk/tolerance in collaboration with manufacturing engineering, quality- / product assurance and production planning and support processes
    

    Support the investment/Capex planning and execution by ensuring to meet the planned financial budgets  
    

    Collaboration in the non-conformance process and measures for route cause analyses, corrective and preventive measures
    

    Support of the Industrial Engineering team in quotations, concept work and developments
    

    Proactively communicates and aligns with the adjacent Production Manager for best practice and synergies within the division
    

    Takes the managerial responsibility towards the direct reports, performing the HR processes such as competence planning, recruitment, performance management, development etc.
    

    Lead and develop the team in accordance with the company values as well as business strategy and goals  
    

    Lead and develop the team to create high engagement, good work environment and positive team spirit
    

    Develop and encourage the culture of diversity, equity and inclusion in our organization



Your Story



Must’s:  

    Master’s or bachelor’s degree in technical studies, preferably in production related diploma  

    Management track record in an industry environment

    Solid technical and production background in a project-based industry

    Understanding of Quality standards and Health & Safety regulations  

    Experience in applying Operational Excellence Methods



Nice to have’s:

    Manager experience in a regulated environment

    Space or Aerospace experience

Why Beyond Gravity?



To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.

You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!

We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!



🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying before 31/08/2027. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​



For questions regarding the position, please contact: ​Björn Diffner | bjoern.diffner@beyondgravity.com

​

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Breno Silva | breno.silva@beyondgravity.com

​

Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

​

Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Design Manager - Mechanical
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager - Mechanical to lead the mechanical and plumbing design delivery for our EPC projects for data center projects. This role sits within the Design Engineering function and is responsible for directing and quality-controlling the work of external engineering consultants, ensuring mechanical and plumbing designs are delivered on time, to budget and in line with  technical, safety, and operational standards for mission-critical facilities.

The Mechanical Senior Design Manager acts as the technical authority and single point of accountability for mechanical and plumbing design across assigned projects, working closely with other design disciplines, project delivery teams and both internal and external stakeholders to ensure a fully coordinated, constructible and operationally sound design solution.

Leadership of External Design Consultants

• Direct, brief, and manage external mechanical and plumbing engineering consultants across all project design stages, from concept through to issued-for-construction (IFC) and as-built documentation.

• Set clear design deliverables, quality expectations, and programme milestones for consultants, and hold them accountable against the agreed scope, fee, and schedule.

• Review and critically challenge consultant deliverables — calculations, schematics, drawings, specifications, and equipment schedules — before issue, ensuring technical robustness and compliance.

• Identify design risks, gaps, or underperformance early and drive timely corrective action with consultant teams.

Mechanical & Plumbing Technical Oversight

• Provide senior technical oversight of HVAC and cooling system design for data center environments, including CRAH/CRAC units, chilled water systems, chillers, free/adiabatic cooling, air handling, and airflow management.

• Oversee plumbing, drainage, and fire protection system design (including pre-action and other special hazard suppression systems typical of data center white space and support areas).

• Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and client/industry requirements (e.g. ASHRAE, local building and mechanical codes, Uptime Institute Tier requirements, and client-specific design criteria).

• Support resiliency, redundancy, and availability targets (e.g. N, N+1, 2N configurations) appropriate to each project's target tier and client specification.

Multi-Discipline Coordination

• Act as the mechanical/plumbing lead within the wider multi-discipline design team, coordinating closely with electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, and fire/life-safety disciplines.

• Drive resolution of cross-discipline clashes and interface issues through structured coordination reviews, including BIM/model-based coordination where applicable.

• Ensure mechanical and plumbing design integrates cleanly with construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and site logistics.

Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as the primary mechanical/plumbing design point of contact for internal stakeholders (project directors, project managers, construction teams, procurement) and external stakeholders (clients, authorities having jurisdiction, third-party reviewers, and commissioning agents).

• Present design status, key decisions, and risks clearly to stakeholders at design reviews and project governance meetings.

• Support commercial and procurement processes by providing technical input on consultant scopes, equipment selection,and vendor/contractor queries.

jobs.title: Media & Content Creator (AI-Enhanced)
jobs.description:
Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad

Love photography, storytelling, social media, and Arctic adventures?

We're looking for a creative and energetic Content & Media Creator to capture the magic of Finnish Lapland and share it with audiences around the world.

From the Northern Lights and snowy landscapes to unforgettable guest experiences, you'll create inspiring content that showcases two of Finland's most unique Arctic destinations.

We are offering you a permanent, full-time position (159 hours/month), with the start date to be agreed upon. We follow the collective agreement for the tourism and restaurant industry (MaRa TES).



Key Responsibilities

* Create engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other digital platforms.

* Capture high-quality photos and videos of our resorts, nature, and guest experiences.

* Edit content for social media, websites, and marketing campaigns.

* Help grow and manage our social media presence through creative storytelling.

* Stay ahead of social media trends and use modern AI tools to enhance creativity and productivity.



Qualifications & Experiences

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Media, Communications, Photography, Film, Graphic Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience with a strong portfolio).

* Minimum 2 years of experience in content creation, social media, photography, videography, or digital marketing.

* Strong photography and short-form video skills.

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut, or similar tools.

* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, or similar is an advantage.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Creative, organized, self-motivated, and passionate about travel and storytelling.



Additional Skills

* Hospitality or tourism industry experience.

* Drone photography or videography.

* Influencer collaborations.

Du er samtidig en god kollega, har et godt humør og sætter pris på et arbejdsmiljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden og får tingene til at fungere.

 

Hvad får du hos os?

Hos PRONOR får du en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en vigtig del af vores afdeling i Aarhus.

Vi har en åben og uformel organisation med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling. Du får mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige tekniske opgaver og bruge din erfaring i praksis.

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.
Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.



Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

HVEM LEDER VI EFTER:

Da Lea er gået på barsel, søger vi en omsorgsfuld og livsglad pædagog, som har lyst til at være medskaber af et omsorgsfuldt lærerigt børnemiljø. Vi søger en pædagog, der sammen med vi andre kan være en aktiv medskaber af et rigt børneliv. Vi er et engageret og inspirerende personaleteam, hvor der bl.a. er fokus på arbejdsglæde, begejstring, forundring, forvandling, anerkendelse, relationer og faglig stolthed. Du skal i dette selskab være med til at bruge vores hus, vores skønne uderum og naturen omkring os til at give børnene en aktiv og lærerig dag.

HVEM KOMMER DU TIL AT ARBEJDE MED:

Børnehaven Højvang er en privat børnehave med 44 børn i alderen 2-6 år. Vi bor i Skæring/Egå tæt på skov og strand, og derfor skal du også gerne have en interesse i udeliv.

Vi er en personalegruppe på otte engagerede kolleger. Vi har åbne døre, således at børnene har mulighed for at bevæge sig rundt i hele huset og indgå i leg og aktiviteter efter eget ønske. Det betyder, at man engagerer sig i alle husets børn og forældre. Du vil opleve personalegruppen som en grundglad, social og imødekommende gruppe af kvinder og mænd, som sætter samarbejde på tværs af huset højt.

Vi er på gulvet sammen med børnene og møder dem positivt med glæde og varme. Det skal være udfordrende, sjovt og givende at gå på arbejde, og vi ved, at vi er hinandens forudsætninger for at lykkes med vores pædagogik og skabe et godt børneliv for børnene i Højvang.

VI TILBYDER:

  • en fast stilling som pædagog i et hus med mange muligheder og "højt til loftet", hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling.

  • et hus med fokus på det gode børneliv for alle børn.

  • et hus med åbenhed for nye ideer og tiltag

  • et hus hvor du kan være medskaber af, samt sætte dit eget præg på pædagogikken og faglige retning i tæt samarbejde med kolleger.

  • et hus med stor forældreopbakning og en engageret forældregruppe, der har overskud til både at yde og stille krav til et godt trivsels- og læringsmiljø for deres børn.

VI FORVENTER, AT DU

  • har noget på hjertet for det enkelte barn.

  • har en særlig interesse i aldersgruppen samt viden og færdigheder til at være medskaber af den pædagogiske hverdag.

  • er uddannet pædagog og kan bruge din viden aktivt med børnene.

  • vil dialogen, reflektionen og kan gribe hverdagen, så at både store og små bliver set, hørt og værdsat.

jobs.title: IT Security Specialist to Bonava in Stockholm
jobs.description:
Lead and develop IT security at Bonava in Stockholm. Work with Azure, Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity in a cloud-first environment

At Bonava, we are not only building houses, we are also creating homes and neighborhoods where people live their lives. To keep our digital world safe, we´re now looking for an IT Security Specialist to lead and develop our cybersecurity landscape.This is a broad role where you will combine strategic vision with hands-on expertise. You will work closely with colleagues across infrastructure, governance and operations to strengthen our security posture, drive continuous improvement and ensure our cloud-first environment remains secure, compliant and resilient.If you are motivated by taking ownership, influencing security strategies and working with modern Microsoft technologies in a business-critical environment, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

At Bonava, you will have the opportunity to shape how we protect our systems, services and data moving forward. You will join an organization where security is an important enabler for the business and where your expertise will influence both strategy and operations.

You will have the opportunity to:

    Take overall responsibility for IT security across Bonava
    Work in a cloud-first environment built primarily on Microsoft Azure
    Influence and develop security frameworks, processes and ways of working
    Combine strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical work
    Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the wider business
    Enjoy a flexible hybrid working model from our central Stockholm office

Your Challenge

As IT Security Specialist, you will take overall responsibility for IT security at Bonava. This is a broad role where you will work closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders to continuously strengthen the organization’s security posture.

You will:

    Strengthen and maintain security across Bonava’s systems and data
    Monitor the threat landscape and initiate preventive measures
    Manage and develop security infrastructure
    Educate users and promote a strong security culture across the organization
    Drive improvement initiatives related to security and compliance
    Provide informed guidance to management on security risks, incidents and strategic priorities to enhance the organization’s security posture

The Team and Workplace

You will be part of the IT Infrastructure and Compliance team, working alongside colleagues within infrastructure, governance and operations.

Bonava operates with a cloud-first IT strategy, primarily leveraging Microsoft Azure. While the focus is on modern cloud-based solutions, the environment remains hybrid, with certain systems and services still managed on- premises.

The position is based in central Stockholm and offers a hybrid work model with flexibility to work from home.

About You

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have a few years of experience within IT Security or Infrastructure and enjoy working in an environment where strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving go hand in hand.

You also have:

    Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security tools, like Defender, Intune and Sentinel
    Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Intune and automation
    Understanding of Azure environments and hybrid setups
    Understanding of network security principles
     Experience working with enterprise network environments
    Skills in scripting, preferably PowerShell or Python
    A proactive, structured and responsible approach
    Excellent communication skills in English

As a person, you are collaborative and take initiative to move your work forward. You are a clear and confident communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across the organization. You exercise good judgement, stay up to date with developments in the cybersecurity landscape and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

It is considered a plus if you have experience working with governance, risk and compliance frameworks, as well as log management and analysis. Swedish language skills are also considered an advantage.

Let´s Connect!

We have chosen to work with Ada Digital in this hiring process. Their recruitment process focuses on transparency, inclusion and a fast moving candidate experience. And now we want to know more about you – on your own terms! To apply, please fill out the short form, briefly motivate why you are interested in the position, and attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile. No additional documentation is needed. You can then, in real-time, follow your application online as our recruiters are working with it. We work with a continues selection process which means we might hire a candidate before the final apply date, so apply already today! Interested and want to know more? Please contact our recruiter today.  We are looking forward to connecting soon!

jobs.title: Ravintolatyöntekijä, Hesburger Prisma Seppälä
jobs.description:
Primary location:
JYVÄSKYLÄ

Etsimme nyt RAVINTOLATYÖNTEKIJÄÄ Hesburger Prisma Seppälään. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja työtunteja on 20 h / 3 vkoa.Monipuoliset työpäiväsi koostuvat mm. asiakaspalvelusta, herkullisten tuotteidemme valmistuksesta sekä ravintolan siisteyttä ylläpitävistä tehtävistä. Prisma Seppälän Hesburgerin lisäksi voit työskennellä osittain myös Buffa&Pressossa sekä Hesburgerin Sokoksen toimipisteellä.

Odotamme sinulta:aikaisempaa kokemusta pikaruokatehtävistä
innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tiimityöstä ja nautit työskentelystä vilkkaassa työympäristössä
tartut reippaasti työtehtäviin ja hoidat hommasi ripeästi ja huolellisesti
haluat työskennellä joustavasti eri vuoroissa – palvelemme asiakkaitamme laajoilla aukioloilla
palvelet asiakkaita sujuvalla suomen kielellä

Eduksesi katsomme aikaisemman kokemuksen Hesburgerissa tai ravintolamaailmassa työskentelystä, mutta tärkeintä halu oppia uutta ja työskennellä tehokkaasti. Perehdytämme sinut hommaan huolellisesti ja tukenasi on mahtava työporukka ja ravintolapäällikkö Tomi.

Palkka perustuu matkailu- ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaan työehtosopimukseen ja on 12,21 - 13,58 € / h + lisät. Meillä sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon, joka on jopa 1,50 € per tehty työtunti. Meillä saat käyttöösi myös Keskimaan huiput henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä: https://keskimaa.fi/henkilostoedut/

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Tomi Turunen puh. 0107675473

Hae tehtävää viimeistään 03.09.2026, mutta älä jää odottamaan, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuajalla ja paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

S-ryhmän sisäinen hakija – huomioithan, että rekrytointiin liittyvä viestintä keskittyy Workday-sovellukseen, seuraathan siis omaa Workday-sovellustasi aktiivisesti!

Meillä tehdään ihan tavallista työtä, jossa on harvinaisen selkeät tavoitteet. Tueksesi saat poikkeuksellisen kivan työporukan sekä reilun ja osaavan esihenkilön.

Työyhteisötutkimuksemme mukaan 94 % työntekijöistämme suosittelisi meitä työpaikkana ja meille on myönnetty Innostavimmat työpaikat tunnustus vuodesta 2015 lähtien. Arvot näkyvät arjessamme: teemme töitä usein ilolla, välillä sisulla, aina sydämellä ja yhdessä.

Lue lisää ihan tavallisesta arjestamme sekä epätavallisen hyvistä henkilöstöeduistamme: https://keskimaa.fi/toissa-meilla

Rekrytoinnissa apuna toimii yhteistyökumppanimme Riina StaffPointilta. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy Osuuskauppa Keskimaalle.

jobs.title: Project SCM Specialist
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Join HVDC as a Project SCM Specialist!

Bring your expertise to our innovative team at Hitachi Energy and help create a greener future with world-leading technology. HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) develops and sells DC transmission systems globally, used for long-distance electricity transmission and submarine cables.

As part of our Global Supply Chain Management, you'll contribute to major infrastructure projects worldwide, working closely with end customers and enjoying vast career opportunities. If you thrive on complex projects and have a problem-solving and curious mindset, this role is for you!

We value diversity and collaboration, ensuring everyone feels respected and included. Join us and make a difference! #diversity #genderequity #inclusion.

How you’ll make an impact:

    As Project SCM Specialist you will be the focal point between HVDC and our suppliers during the execution phase of our projects.
    You will work closely with Project SCM Managers, Logistic Planners, Engineers, Documentation Control and Suppliers follow up and secure that the equipment and documentation deliveries from our Suppliers is according to agreed time, cost and quality.
    You work in a team with other Project SCM Specialists and will take on equipment’s or project responsibility.
    During the project execution you need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow-up on all equipment deliveries with our suppliers and internal stakeholders.
    During project execution you will also drive, attend and provide information to kick-off and clarification meetings with suppliers.
    You will work closely with the Project SCM Manager to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
    Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background

    You have an academic degree in a relevant field: Supply Chain Management, Business & Administration, or Engineering (or equivalent work experience).
    Preferably you have 2-3 years of professional experience working in close interaction with suppliers and have practice stakeholder management to some extent.
    You should also have the ability to stay structured and organized even under pressure and when dealing with many tasks and stakeholders in parallel.
    Enjoy working in project-based environments and collaborating with people from different functions, educational backgrounds, and cultures.
    Excellent written and spoken English skills, as the role involves working in a global organization with international suppliers.
    Strong communication and relationship-building skills are required in this role.
    On a personal level, you are a collaborative and reliable team player with an independent and results oriented working style.

Additional information

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

This is a hybrid position where you will be based at the Ludvika Hitachi Energy office, with the possibility of working from home up to a couple times per week.

More About Us​​

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
    Health care and wellness allowance ​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​​

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Eva Schölin, eva.scholin@hitachienergy.com

Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107 38 70 43; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85.

jobs.title: Teamkoordinator
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om en hverdag som social- og sundhedsassistent der er præget af nærvær og samarbejde, med mulig for administrativt arbejde som teamkoordinator.

Frit Valg Svane Pleje søger lige nu en social og sundhedsassistent stilling til hjemmepleje i vores afdeling i Nørresundby.

Vi har gennem den seneste tid gennemgået en rivende udvikling i vores arbejdsgange i forhold til Implementering af den nye ældre reform – til gavn for kollegaer og borgere. Vi er kommet en lang vej og ønsker at fortsætte den gode udvikling. I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi i teams på tværs af hele døgnet for at styrke samarbejdet kollegaer imellem og skabe den helt rigtige opmærksomhed og sparring på vores borgeres forløb og pleje. Teamkoordinator funktionen giver mulighed for at være bindeled mellem plejen og din planlægger. Arbejdet består primært af administrative opgaver og faglig sparring med kollegaer.

Vi søger en kollega, der ønsker at tage del i denne udvikling og yde den bedste pleje til vores borgere. Vi tilbyder en fast stilling til vores dagvagtteam med rig mulighed for indflydelse på egne arbejdstider, og udvikling af arbejdsområder samt kollegial sparring.

Opgaverne som social- og sundhedsassistent er mangeartede, men overordnet kan nævnes:

  • Er på kontoret hele dagen, køre ud i marken i akutte situationer.

  • Bindeled mellem kollegaer og planlægger.

  • Telefonpasning hele dagen.

  • Håndtere nødkalds telefonen + sætte besøg på planerne. (registrere tilstand på borgerne og være opfølgende på ekstraaftalerne)

  • Optimering af planer/aflysninger.

  • Vagtdækning.

  • Håndtere sygdom i hverdagene kl. 6,30, et team ad gangen på skift hver 3. uge.

  • Holde Quinyx opdateret ved vagtændringer.

  • Tidlig opsporing – tage ud til borgere ved behov.

  • Superbruger i Cura og skærmenhed.

  • Orientere sig i Cura – indlagt/aflysninger/ekstra aftaler/ændringer i visitationen.

  • Teammøder – i samarbejde med planlægger & fagligleder

 

Vil du med på holdet?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social og sundhedsassistent og som brænder for at arbejde med borgere i eget hjem, der gennem helhjertet og professionel indsats vil gøre en stor forskel for vores borgeres hverdag og trivsel.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at:

·         Du har et kæmpe omsorgsgen, som du ønsker at sætte i spil i en stilling

·         Er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et tværfagligt team

·         Kan agere professionelt og udvise stor tålmodighed og forståelse for menneskers situation

·         Du er dygtig til at kommunikere og arbejde tværprofessionelt

·         Du kan skabe tryghed og liv gennem nærvær og dialog

·         Du er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

·         Du er omstillingsparat, da opgaverne er omskiftelige og det daglige arbejde kræver fleksibilitet

Vi kan tilbyde:

·         En fast stilling på 35 timer – ansvarshavende SSA hver 4 weekend fra kl. 6-15

·         Et grundigt introduktionsforløb, hvor du kører sammen med en kollega den første tid og bliver oplært i vores systemer

·         Stor frihed under ansvar

·         Muligheden for kompetenceudvikling og kollegial sparring

·         En lydhør ledelse, der forstår at den enkelte medarbejder er en stærk ressource

 

Sammen skaber vi gode rammer for din ansættelse
Dit primære arbejdssted er i Nørresundby, hvor du møder ind og hvis der er behov for at hjælpe i plejen, så er der på adressen er der mulighed for at låne en af vores firmabiler/ el cykler, som står til rådighed.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold
Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt eller efter nærmere aftale. Der indkaldes til samtale i uge 39.Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte dagligleder Jannike Frølund på +41 40 20 10 eller på e-mailadressen aalborg@svanepleje.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

jobs.title: Vauvauinnin ja uimakoulun ohjaaja, Tampere
jobs.description:
Oletko työtä pelkäämätön, ihmisten kanssa toimeen tuleva ja liikunnallinen? Pidätkö lapsista? Sinulla on myös rohkeaa asennetta tarttua asioihin. Työ meillä vaatii tekijältään vastuuntuntoista asennetta ja rohkeutta tarttua toimeen. Haemme vauvauinninohjaajia ja uimaopettajia Tampereelle Uimakoulu Pikku Joutseneen. Kyseessä on ohjaustyö tarpeen mukaa. Valitsemme ensisijaisesti henkilöitä, jotka voivat ohjata arki-iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin ja kouluttautua loka-marraskuun aikana.

Kelluta Oy kehittää ja toteuttaa vauvauinti- ja uimakoulupalveluja. Meillä on vahva vesiliikunnan ammattilaisten kouluttamisen taustaosaaminen ja koulutamme säännöllisesti alan ammattilaisia niin Suomessa kuin ulkomaillakin.

Olemme alan edelläkävijä ja siksi haluamme taloomme alan parhaat tekijät. Tarjolla on haasteellinen, luova työ ja kilpailukykyinen palkka. Koulutamme tarvittaessa, eli työtä voi hakea, vaikka ei ole vielä esimerkiksi uimaopettaja tai vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakoulutusta. Työ vaatii täysi-ikäisyyden.

Edellytämme valmiutta kouluttautua konseptimme mukaiseksi ohjaajaksi. Suomalainen Vesiliikuntainstituutti tarjoaa Vauvauinninohjaaja- ja uimaopettajavalmennuksen tehtävään valituille. Eduksi katsotaan uimaopettajan tutkinto (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus) ja/tai Vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakurssi (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus).

Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Kokki Break Sokos Hotel Bomballe
jobs.description:
Primary location:
NURMES

Kokki Break Sokos Hotel Bomballe

Huikaisevan kauniin Pielisen rannalla Pohjois-Karjalassa sijaitseva Bomba on ainutlaatuinen ja omaperäinen matkailukohde ympäri vuoden. Bomban uudestisyntynyt kylpylähotelli hellii jokaista aistia. Haluaisimme saada sinut mukaan rakentamaan omalla työpanoksellasi elämyksiä asiakkaillemme.

Haetaan kiireestä syttyvää sekä monipuolisesta työnkuvasta nauttivaa kokkia osaksi Bomban keittiötiimiä. A'la cartesta aamiaiseen, kokouksesta cateringiin ja kaikkea maan sekä taivaan väliltä on luvassa ainutlaatuisessa matkailukohteessa Pielisen rannalla. Sinulla tulee olla kokin koulutus tai aikaisempi työkokemus ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä. Odotamme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, paineensietokykyinen ja tehokas henkilö. Sinä haluat sekä kehittyä omassa työssäsi ja kehittää työyhteisön toimintaa. Arvostat hyvää ruokaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaskokemusta. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan.

Työtehtävä on vakituinen ja tunteja tarjoamme sinulle 75 h / 3 vk. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijöillämme on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistaan. Lisäksi saat käyttöösi erinomaiset PKO:n ja S-ryhmän henkilökuntaeduthttps://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut. Meillä työnantaja on vakuuttanut jokaisen työntekijän myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella, ja liikkumistasi kannustamme Epassilla.

Haku tehtävään päättyy 11.9.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa ravintolapäällikkö Jani Tiainen (7.-11.9.2026) jani.tiainen@sok.fi. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin ehdokkaisiin rekrytointiprosessin edetessä.

jobs.title: Postdoc in material flow analysis and resource management
jobs.description:
The SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a postdoctoral position in material flow analysis and resource management. The position is initially offered for one year, with the possibility of extension depending on available funding.

The position will focus on quantitative assessment of material and resource systems. The work will involve analysis of material stocks and flows, resource use, waste management and recycling, and associated environmental impacts across different material systems and end-use sectors.

The postdoc will apply material flow analysis, life cycle assessment and scenario analysis to support research on resource and waste management. Application areas may include plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials and other material systems.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

·         Quantifying material stocks and flows across different material systems and end-use sectors

·         Assessing secondary resource availability and future resource demand

·         Applying life cycle assessment and scenario analysis

·         Contributing to scientific publications and research projects

·         Contributing to teaching and supervision within relevant areas

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

·         A PhD in environmental engineering, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field

·         Strong experience with material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, and scenario analysis

·         Strong quantitative and analytical skills

·         A strong publication record in relevant international journals

·         Experience in international research collaboration

·         Good written and spoken English

·         Ability to work independently and as part of a research team

Experience with plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials or related resource systems will be considered an advantage. 

Research environment

As a postdoc, you will conduct independent research, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy and energy system optimization.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with external partners, including international conferences and research visits.

Application

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying

  • PhD degree certificate(s)

  • A list of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

Submission guideline: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is 10. September 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

Assessment and selection process 

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

Read about the Assessment and selection process.    

Employment terms 

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from 15 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s). 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering. 

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu.

jobs.title: TIG-welder, Vihti
jobs.description:
Are an experienced TIG-welder looking for a job in the Uusimaa area?

Location: Vihti
Employment: Fixed term employment contract, possibility for a permanent employment contract
Salary: Competitive salary based on your skills and experience

We are seeking an experienced TIG welder for our client company in Vihti for a long-term position. If you have strong experience in aluminium welding and are interested in a long-term job with diverse projects, you might be the person we are looking for!

About the role

In this role, you will work on a wide variety of welding tasks, as the welded products vary. The work is carried out in modern and well-lit facilities in two shifts 40 hours per week. Material thicknesses range from approximately 1 to 20 millimeter. If you are relocating from another location, we can assist with accommodation arrangements if needed. Welding tests will be required before starting the work.

We expect from you

* Solid experience in TIG welding, especially with aluminium

* Good technical skills and the ability to read technical drawings

* Precision and attention to detail in your work

* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

We offer you

* A possibility for a long-term employment relationship

* Competitive salary based on your skills and experience

* A comfortable and modern working environment with up-to-date equipment

* Assistance with finding accommodation if needed

You will be employed by Wellpack, a company founded in 2013 that provides high-quality staffing services. Wellpack connects skilled workers with quality jobs and contributes to building employment in Finland.

Apply quick!

Please submit your application as soon as possible via the Apply link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our system. In your application, describe your experience in industrial work, skills, and education background. We will contact selected candidates for interviews during the application period. Applications are processed continuously and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information about the position, contact Wellpacks recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Safari- ja aktiviteettiopas
jobs.description:
Nuorgamin Lomakeskus Oy on pieni kodikas perheyritys Suomen ja EU:n pohjoisimmassa kylässä - Nuorgamissa. Lomakeskus sijaitsee upeissa avarissa tunturimaisemissa, aivan Norjan ja Jäämeren läheisyydessä, Tenojoen rannalla. Lomakeskus on toiminut jo yli 50 vuotta saman perheen käsissä. Yrityksemme tärkeitä arvoja ovat kestävä matkailu, paikallisuus ja luonto. Henkilökuntaamme kuuluu 2-8 vakituista ja kausityöntekijää omistajaperheen lisäksi. . Haemme joukkoomme safari- ja aktiviteettioppaita talvikauteen 2026-2027. Työt alkavat joulukuussa ja kestävät maaliskuun loppuun asti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Asiakasryhmämme ovat pieniä, ja haluammekin painottaa työssämme asiakkaiden aitoa kohtaamista, vieraanvaraisuutta ja henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tavoitteenamme on luoda asiakkaillemme ainutlaatuinen elämysmatka pohjoisimman Lapin arktisella tundra-alueella.

Safari- ja aktiviteettioppaana tehtäviisi kuuluu kansainvälisten viikkoasiakkaidemme ohjaaminen kelkkasafareilla, lumikenkäretkillä sekä muilla tunturiretkillä ja ulkoaktiviteeteilla. Opastöiden lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu aktiviteettien valmistelu- ja purkutyöt, huoltotehtävät, eräruokailut, asiakaspalvelu sekä asiakkaiden kuljetustehtävät.

Oppaamme työskentelevät niin yhdessä, yksin kuin pareittainkin. Etsimme opasta, joka on reipas, vastuuntuntoinen tiimipelaaja ja ystävällinen asiakaspalvelija.

Edellytämme sinulta:

- Kokemusta matkailualan opastyöstä, mieluiten Lapista

- Oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä

- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa

- B-ajokorttia sekä kokemusta moottorikelkan käsittelystä


Tarjoamme sinulle

- Kokoaikaisen työn talvikaudeksi 2026-2027

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan 14-17 €/tunti kokemuksen ja osaamisen huomioiden (MARATES)

- Hyvän perehdytyksen ja osaavien kollegoiden tuen läpi kauden

- Työsuhdeasumisen (vuokra alkaen 400 €/kk)

- Työpaikkaruokailut: 8 €/lounas ja 4,50 €/aamupala

- Pienen työyhteisön rennon ja yhteisöllisen ilmapiirin

- Erinomaiset vapaa-ajanviettomahdollisuudet kauniissa tunturiluonnossa

- Vuokravälineitä edullisesti luontoharrastuksiin

- Ilmaisen pääsyn kunnan kuntosalille

- Mahdollisuuden vuokrata kauttamme tilapäisesti myös autoa

- Laadukkaan työterveyshuollon


Eduksi katsomme:

- Matkailualan moniosaamisen ja koulutuksen alalta

- Muun sujuvan kielitaidon (esim. saksa, ranska, hollanti)

- Ensiapu-kortin

- Hygieniapassin

- Pohjois-Lapin alueellisen tuntemuksen


Jos kiinnostuit ja koet, että kausityö Suomen huipulla olisi juuri sinua varten, lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi meille sähköpostitse. Etenemme työntekijöiden valinnassa jo hakuajan aikana sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 20.9.2026. Ilmoitamme valinnan etenemisestä ja päätöksistä henkilökohtaisesti.
