jobs.description: Statut : Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le médecin militaire est le dernier maillon de la chaîne e sur le terrain des opérations, après le Combat Med et l'infirmier militaire; En mission, il est capable de prendre en charge des militaires blessés dans toutes les conditions; Sa formation lui permet d'appliquer ses compétences es dans un environnement militaire soumis à des contraintes tactiques et logistiques. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. Missions principalesPiloter et accompagner les équipes administratives, projets et techniques dans un environnement multisitesDéfinir et déployer les stratégies de rénovation, de maintenance et d'entretien du parc immobilier comptant actuellement plus de  logements en propriété pleineÉlaborer et mettre en œuvre les stratégies de gestion des immeubles détenus en propriété pleine ou en copropriétéAccompagner et conseiller la Direction dans ses prises de décisions stratégiques et opérationnellesConcevoir, déployer et optimiser les méthodologies, processus et procédures du serviceÉlaborer, suivre et piloter les budgets du serviceRédiger les cahiers des charges dans le cadre des marchés publics et élaborer et mettre en place des accords-cadres Formation et expérience requisesFormation de niveau Bac+3 minimum en immobilier, gestion de l'immobilier ou constructionExpérience d'au moins 5 ans dans le management d'équipes, l'administration de biens immobiliers ou toute autre profession proche de la constructionMaitrise de la réglementation luxembourgeoise (marchés publics, syndics, construction, immobilier etc. ) Compétences et aptitudes requisesMaîtrise parfaite des outils courants MS Office, idéalement d'outils GMAOMaîtrise obligatoire des langues française et allemande. La connaissance du luxembourgeois est un atoutExcellente capacité rédactionnellePermis de conduire BAutonomie et esprit d'équipeSens de l'organisation, disponibilité et forte capacité d'adaptationContact aisé et respectueux Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Un métier porteur de sens : Au Fonds du Logement, chaque mission a un impact concret : accueillir, loger et accompagner. Nos  collaborateurs contribuent activement au développement du logement abordable au Luxembourg et à l'accompagnement des ménages.Un établissement tourné vers l'avenir, portant desprojets innovants et d'envergure inscrits dans une démarche durable et circulaire.Une culture portée par des valeurs fortes : le respect, la collaboration, l'engagement, l'éthique et la qualité.Un environnement de travail stable et attractif, favorisant le bien-être de nos collaborateurs et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.À ce titre, nous vous proposons :Un contrat stable au sein d'un établissement public reconnuUne rémunération attractive tenant compte de votre expérience et de votre niveau de responsabilitéUne allocation de famille, sous réserve d'éligibilitéUne augmentation salariale annuelle garantieUne carte dédynamiquer Pluxee Lunch jours de congés annuelsDes horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité de télétravaillerDes opportunités de développement professionnel : mobilité interne, budget individuel de formation, cours de langues.Des infrastructures modernes et facilement accessiblesDes évènements internes organisés par notre Fun Team tout au long de l'année (afterwork, teambuilding, visites culturelles et de patrimoine, activités sportives, etc.) Notre processus de recrutement :Nous accordons une attention particulier/ière à la qualité et à la transparence de notre processus de recrutement.Les étapes :1.       Réception de votre candidature avant le  septembre .       Analyse et présélection des candidatures3.       Entretien avec votre futur manager et un membre des Ressources Humaines4.       Entretien avec la direction5.       Validation finale de votre engagement par notre COMEXEn cas d'entretien d'embauche, un extrait de  vous sera demandé conformément aux exigences liées à la fonction.Signataires de la Charte de la Diversité Lëtzebuerg, nous nous engageons à promouvoir l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Expert Google Ads Freelance -  % Télétravail (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Google Ads Specialist expérimenté(e) pour piloter et optimiser les campagnes d'acquisition digitale de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Google Ads : de l'audit et la définition de la stratégie jusqu'au lancement, au suivi et à l'optimisation continue des campagnes, avec une approche résolument orientée performance, conversions et rentabilité. Vos responsabilités Stratégie & Audit Google Ads Auditer les comptes Google Ads existants et identifier rapidement les opportunités d'amélioration. Définir la stratégie d'acquisition en fonction des objectifs, du marché et du budget de chaque client. Structurer les comptes et campagnes afin de maximiser leur efficacité. Identifier les principaux leviers permettant d'améliorer les performances et la rentabilité. Création & Gestion des Campagnes Créer, paramétrer et gérer des campagnes Search, Display, Remarketing et Performance Max. Réaliser les recherches de mots-clés et analyser les intentions de recherche. Structurer les groupes d'annonces, audiences et ciblages. Rédiger, tester et optimiser les annonces et différents assets. Analyser régulier/ièrement les termes de recherche et gérer les mots-clés négatifs. Budget & Optimisation Définir et optimiser les stratégies d'enchères. Piloter l'allocation des budgets entre les différentes campagnes. Identifier les campagnes, audiences, mots-clés et annonces les plus performants. Mettre en place des tests et expérimentations afin d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Ajuster les campagnes en fonction des performances et des objectifs de rentabilité. Tracking & Analytics Mettre en place, vérifier et optimiser le tracking des conversions. Exploiter Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager pour mesurer les performances. Contrôler la qualité et la fiabilité des données remontées. Comprendre et analyser les problématiques d'attribution et de parcours de conversion. Performance & ROI Suivre les principaux KPI : impressions, CTR, CPC, taux de conversion, CPA et ROAS. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Concevoir des reportings clairs et orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions et nouvelles fonctionnalités Google Ads. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Google Ads, idéalement acquise sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Google Ads : excellente maîtrise des campagnes Search et des stratégies d'enchères Google. Bonne connaissance de Display, Remarketing et Performance Max. Analytics & Tracking : bonne maîtrise de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager ainsi que des mécanismes de tracking, conversion et attribution. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des enjeux de génération de leads et d'acquisition digitale. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément, à prioriser les actions et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. Références : la capacité à présenter des cas concrets de campagnes gérées et de résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. Détails de la collaboration Statut : Freelance / Indépendant Localisation :  % télétravail / Remote Démarrage : Dès que possible Type de clients : Principalement TPE / PME Mode de collaboration : Au forfait ou en régie selon les projets Candidature Merci d'envoyer votre CV à . Pour toute information complémentaire, vous pouvez nous contacter au + .

jobs.title: Administrateur systèmes et infrastructures sécurisées (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Le Centre des technologies de l'information de l'État (CTIE) est l'administration luxembourgeoise en charge des services IT pour le gouvernement, les ministères et les administrations luxembourgeoises et un des acteurs centraux en matier/ière d'eGovernment. Nos services couvrent tous les domaines IT, découvrez nos missions sur notre site internet https://ctie.gouvernement.lu/fr/l-administration.html. Nous offrons: Un environnement technologique varié et favorable à l'innovation; Des projets d'envergure nationale / européenne au service des citoyens; Des projets centrés sur les utilisateurs; Une atmosphère collégiale, dynamique et multilingue; Une administration qui valorise les compétences des collaborateurs et encourage la mobilité interne. Missions Votre mission: Vous êtes un acteur clé du bon fonctionnement des infrastructures informatiques soutenant la production des documents administratifs sécurisés de l'État; Dans ce rôle, vous participez à l'exploitation quotidien/ienne des environnements techniques, à la résolution des incidents, au maintien de la continuité des services et à l'évolution des plateformes technologiques; Vous intervenez au cœur d'un environnement où la disponibilité, la sécurité et la qualité de service sont essentielles. Vos responsabilités: Assurer l'exploitation des infrastructures critiques: Garantir le bon fonctionnement des systèmes soutenant les activités de production; Exploiter et maintenir les environnements de développement, de test et de production; Assurer le monitoring, la supervision et le suivi des performances des infrastructures; Participer aux opérations de maintenance et d'amélioration continue; Contribuer activement à la disponibilité et à la continuité des services. Analyser et résoudre les incidents: Diagnostiquer les incidents techniques affectant les infrastructures, applications ou équipements spécialisés; Identifier les causes des dysfonctionnements et coordonner leur résolution; Assurer le suivi des incidents jusqu'à leur clôture complète; Participer à l'amélioration continue de la stabilité et de la fiabilité des systèmes; Intervenir dans la recherche de solutions lorsqu'un problème implique plusieurs composants techniques (systèmes, réseaux, sécurité, équipements ou applications). Coordonner les différents intervenants techniques: Collaborer avec les équipes spécialisées du CTIE (réseaux, sécurité, infrastructures, bases de données, développement et opérations, etc.); Assurer l'interface avec les fournisseurs et partenaires techniques nationaux et internationaux; Participer au suivi technique des demandes de nos clients, notamment des ministères et administrations, des administrations communales et des représentations diplomatiques; Contribuer aux projets d'évolution des infrastructures et des plateformes techniques. Administrer les infrastructures techniques: Administrer les serveurs Microsoft Windows Server; Gérer les services Active Directory et LDAP; Participer à l'administration et au suivi des infrastructures réseau; Assurer le suivi des mécanismes d'authentification, des certificats numériques et des accès sécurisés; Contribuer à l'exploitation d'environnements virtualisés et des outils de supervision. Participer à l'exploitation d'équipements spécialisés: Contribuer au fonctionnement et au support des équipements de personnalisation de documents sécurisés; Participer au support et à la maintenance des équipements de capture de données biométriques; Collaborer à l'intégration de nouvelles solutions techniques au sein des infrastructures existant/antes; Participer à la gestion des composants liés aux infrastructures de confiance et à la sécurité des systèmes. Profil recherché: Nous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, polyvalent(e) et passionnée par les technologies; Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons un collaborateur capable de comprendre un problème dans sa globalité, d'en analyser les causes et de coordonner efficacement sa résolution; Vous êtes curieux, pragmatique, orienté solution et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement où chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis. Profil Compétences techniques Solide expérience en administration de systèmes et d'infrastructures informatiques; Très bonne connaissance des environnements Microsoft Windows Server; Bonne maîtrise des services Active Directory et LDAP; Bonnes connaissances des infrastructures réseaux (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routage, firewall); Expérience dans l'exploitation d'environnements de production; Connaissances en monitoring et supervision des infrastructures; Bonne compréhension des principes de cybersécurité et de gestion des accès; Expérience dans l'analyse et la résolution d'incidents complexes; Capacité à travailler sur des infrastructures faisant intervenir plusieurs...

jobs.title: Comptable Germanophone - Horaires Flexibles, Taille Humaine (H/F)
jobs.description: Comptable Germanophone - Horaires Flexibles, Taille Humaine Vous souhaitez évoluer dans une fiduciaire reconnue où le développement des compétences est une véritable priorité ? Nous recrutons pour une société implantée au Luxembourg, réunissant une équipe de plus de  professionnels spécialisés dans les domaines comptables, fiscaux, juridiques et administratifs.Grâce à la diversité de sa clientèle, active principalement dans les secteurs commercial et financier, cette fiduciaire offre un cadre de travail stimulant ainsi que de nombreur/euses possibilités d'apprentissage. Vos responsabilités / Comptabilité - Finance - Fiduciaire - Fiscalité - TVA Il vous sera demander d'assurer la comptabilité quotidien/ienne et le suivi d'un portefeuille composé principalement de sociétés commerciales.Vous gérerez des dossiers de sociétés établies au Luxembourg ainsi qu'en Allemagne.Préparer les déclarations fiscales et les déclarations de TVA luxembourgeoises et allemandes fera partie de vos responsabilités. Une formation complète sera assurée aux candidats ne maîtrisant pas encore la fiscalité allemande.Vous accompagnerez les clients au quotidien et entretenir une relation professionnelle durable avec des interlocuteurs basés au Luxembourg et en Allemagne. jobs.title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz

Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa liikuntavammaiselle 16-vuotiaalle tytölle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Jyväskylän Palokkaan.

Avustettava istuu pyörätuolissa ja tarvitsee apua arjen toiminnoissa. Avustettava on luonteeltaan kiltti, iloinen ja tulee toimeen kaikkien kanssa.

Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti avustettavan kotona, harrastuksissa tai vapaa-ajalla.

Työtehtävät sisältävät hoitotoimenpiteitä, pukeutumisessa ja ruokailussa avustamista, ostoksilla, elokuvissa ja ulkoilemassa avustamista. Työ sisältää nostoja ja siirtoja, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on työssä eduksi.

Työtä tarjolla 0–30 h/kk, työvuorot pääsääntöisesti arki-iltaisin sekä viikonloppuisin päiväaikaan.

Palkkaus: Heta TES C + mahdolliset lisät.

Työ alkaa 1.9.2026.

Kyseisessä työssä työkokemus/ sopiva koulutus on eduksi , samoin eri kuntoutusalojen koulutus/ työkokemus sekä viittomien tuntemus. Työ sopii hyvin myös alasta kiinnostuneelle opiskelijalle tai osa-aikatyötä tekevälle. Työhön perehdytetään.

Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja täysi-ikäisyyttä. Avustajan toivotaan olevan avoin, positiivinen, oma-aloitteinen ja huumorintajuinen.

Työnantajalla on velvollisuus pyytää työhön valitun työntekijän rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi, kun avustajan työtehtävään kuuluu alle 18-vuotiaiden lasten kanssa työskentely tilanteissa, joissa lapsen huoltaja ei ole läsnä (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

jobs.description:

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

We are looking for an HR Assistant with a generalist profile to support the full employee lifecycle in our Bratislava office. The role combines recruitment, HR administration, employee support, reporting, and coordination of internal HR processes.

Responsibilities
Support recruitment from vacancy publication and candidate screening to interviews and offers.
Coordinate onboarding, probation, internal transfers, and offboarding.
Prepare HR documents and maintain accurate employee records.
Update information in HR systems and prepare regular headcount reports.
Respond to employees’ questions regarding HR policies and internal procedures.
Coordinate performance reviews, training, benefits, and employee-development activities.
Support foreign employees with relocation, residence, and employment documentation.
Communicate with external providers and relevant Slovak authorities.
Assist with company events and employee-engagement initiatives.
Ensure confidentiality and compliance with internal HR standards.

Requirements
At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Good command of Slovak.

Nice to have
Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.title: Technici počítačových sietí a systémov
jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.
Follow established change-management, security, and documentation procedures.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

jobs.title: Outdoor Activity Worker, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Outdoor Activity Workers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä and Hetta for the Christmas season 2026.**

A workday of an Outdoor Activity Worker consists of various tasks including overseeing outdoor activities in a Christmas themed activity area surrounded by Lapland's beautiful nature. You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish is very useful in Saariselkä. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

**In Saariselkä** you will introduce tobogganing, mini-skidoo, kick-sledding or tandem skiing to our guests. You can also be working at the reindeer info, pancake-hut or at the warmup cabin. You might also work as a road crosser, when you make sure that the guests are crossing the road safely, either by snowmobile or by walking. In addition, your work tasks may include clothing and equipment maintenance.

**In Hetta** your workplace can be the toboggan slide or bobsleigh hill, you might be teaching the guests to drive the snowmobile, or you might be serving ginger breads in the snow castle and telling stories about the castle itself. You might also be part of the very important team that organizes the visits to Santa Claus himself. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

**What we expect from you:**

- Energetic and outgoing character

- Flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Good group management skills

- Christmas spirit and willingness to work with families, especially children


**What we offer you:**

- Great team and beautiful working surroundings

- Versatile and variable working days

- Easy way to experience arctic nature

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin in mid-November or at the end of November and will last approximately until the Christmas holidays in Hetta, and until the end of December 2026 in Saariselkä. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

For further information, please contact info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Arcade and VR Operator
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about gaming, customer service, and cutting-edge VR technology? We are looking for an energetic and reliable Arcade & VR Gaming Centre Operator to join our team! In this role, you will be the face of our gaming centre welcoming guests, ensuring a seamless gaming experience, and keeping our facility running smoothly.

DeGameZone is a modern entertainment and recreation venue focused on delivering high-energy arcade and virtual reality (VR) experiences. Combining classic arcade gaming with state-of-the-art VR technology, DeGameZone offers a social hub where gamers, families, and groups can connect, compete, and explore immersive virtual worlds.  
Why Join DeGameZone?
Be at the Center of Entertainment: You get to work in a vibrant, fast-paced environment where creating fun and memorable experiences for guests is the daily goal.
Hands-on Technology: You will gain experience operating and troubleshooting modern VR systems alongside arcade machinery.  
Dynamic Work Atmosphere: Every shift brings a variety of tasks from welcoming guests and running point of sale operations (kassa) to hosting VR sessions and guiding players.
Competitive Compensation & Perks: Enjoy a solid salary (Euro 2,400 to Euro 4,000/month pro-rata), holiday allowance (vakantiegeld), accrued paid leave.
Long-Term Growth: Start with flexible hours (24 to 40 hours per week) with the genuine potential to convert into a permanent contract as the company grows.

jobs.title: Supervisor
jobs.description:
Independently manage our beautiful construction projects, celebrate successes with colleagues and ensure a satisfied client. This is what your job as a supervisor looks like with us.
Vacancy
Supervisor
What will you do?
When the plans for a construction project are finely honed, your work begins. You are the connecting factor between stakeholders (architects, structural engineers, government, clients) on one side, and the construction site (contractors and builders) on the other. You pull, push, massage, steer, and ensure that everything is completed within the given time, quality, and budget. Additionally, you work closely with the supervisor: your eyes and ears on the site. If things don't go as planned, you provide clear, practical advice to get all parties back on track without hesitation. If necessary, you're not afraid to assertively demand compliance. Ensuring the correct execution of the construction contract by the contracting parties is indeed your responsibility, and you take it very seriously. All to successfully conclude the complex, diverse construction projects entrusted to us.
What do you bring?
You're of the type: less talk, more action. Roll up your sleeves and get it done. Through your proactive, well-thought-out initiatives, you effortlessly rally others. In construction projects, the UAV is your bible, and the construction ethos is your natural habitat. You adhere to processes and frameworks when possible, and you're flexible and pragmatic when necessary. Your construction-related education at HBO/WO level provides the right foundation for this. Experience as a construction supervisor is valuable, but the right qualities are more important. For example, if you're currently working as a supervisor and aim to take the next step. We'd like to talk to you further.
What do we offer you?
Stevens Van Dijck may not be a family business, but it feels like one. We are a small, informal organization without frills...

jobs.description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

Upforce history
Founded: 1997
Employees: 10
Temporary workers: 500
SEP Peeters Oirlo
The employment agency SEP Peeters Oirlo was founded in 1997 when it started sending out Polish temporary workers, but the name SEP Peeters was already active in the poultry industry in the early 1980s. The need for additional labour was so great that in 1997 it was decided to move over as a temporary employment agency alongside services in the poultry industry. From 2000, the service provision within the poultry industry was stopped and SEP Peeters switched completely to the temping of labour.
SEP Peeters was based in Oirlo and from here around 600 temporary workers were put to work. Before 1997, only in the poultry industry, but this quickly changed to various sectors such as logistics, production, distribution and construction. SEP Peeters, besides posting temporary workers, also arranged accommodation, transport, insurance and necessary documentation.
In addition to completely unburdening its customers as well as staff, SEP Peeters' strength was communication, openness and listening to the wants and needs. This is why SEP Peeters was good at retaining both its customers and staff and many of these customers still work with Upforce.
Verbeek employment agency
Verbeek temporary employment agency was founded by Jac Verbeek in 1998. The origin of the agency was in Jac Verbeek's horticulture company, where he offered seasonal work to Eastern European employees. From his own experience in horticulture, the idea arose to offer these workers to other companies in the region.
In the early years, Eastern European workers were mainly used for seasonal work. Over time, Verbeek Temporary Employment Agency evolved and the model was expanded to fully staffing. The agency grew steadily and employed about 10 workers during that period.

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher - Molecular Drivers of BRCA1-Related Precancer - - Amsterdam
Job details Application Job description
We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher to join a newly funded Gray Foundation Team Science project tackling one of the most important unsolved problems in cancer prevention: what drives the very first steps of breast cancer initiation in BRCA1 mutation carriers. Working at the interface of human tissue biology, single-cell genomics, spatial imaging, and functional mouse modeling, you will help map the genetic and phenotypic landscape of BRCA1-deficient precancerous cells in prophylactic mastectomy specimens and translate those discoveries into functionally validated driver candidates - a unique opportunity to do science that directly connects to clinical cancer interception.
The Jonkers laboratory at the Netherlands Cancer Institute has built a world-leading platform for functional breast cancer modeling, combining germline genetics, intraductal somatic engineering, and quantitative in vivo imaging. We are now applying that platform to study the biology of BRCA1-associated precancer and are looking for an exceptional postdoctoral researcher to lead this work.
You will work with a novel mouse model that combines germline heterozygous Brca1 deficiency with a dual-color fluorescent reporter that marks cells undergoing Cre-mediated loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in real time. Our preliminary data show that Brca1 LOH cells are actively cleared from the ductal epithelium in vivo, and this clearance is rescued by Trp53 loss. This provides a quantitative and mechanistic benchmark for ranking candidate perturbations.
Candidate driver genes will be introduced somatically at low frequency in mice - closely resembling the occurrence of early mutations in BRCA1 mutation carriers - through intraductal delivery of high-titer lentiviruses encoding Cre with cDNAs for overexpression or CRISPR guides for loss-of-function...

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Legal Operations Manager at Replit, you will be the central point of contact for legal requests across the company and the operational backbone of our contract lifecycle. You will triage and manage incoming legal requests, own contract management end to end, and support broader corporate compliance and data privacy work. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will keep legal operations running smoothly and reduce risk across the business.

Think of yourself as the air traffic controller of our legal universe — making sure every contract, request, and approval lands safely, on time, and in the right hands. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will not just keep Legal running smoothly — it will make the whole company move faster.

If you love building systems, closing loops, and being the person everyone turns to when they need to get something done right, this role was made for you.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Legal Operations

 - Drive the Legal team's operational strategy, understand operational challenges, identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows

 - Implement, maintain, and optimize a best in class AI driven tech stack. Partner cross functionally with AI and GTM/marketing/partnerships teams to identify technologies, negotiate with vendors, and drive implementation.

 - Partner closely with Finance and Legal leadership to manage budget, forecasting, accruals, and track spend

 - Working closely with leadership, own planning cycles, OKRs, and data reporting and metrics

 - Manage outside counsel relationships, including new engagements, billing guidelines invoicing, and e-billing. Drive outside counsel management strategy with a focus on cost discipline and operational accountability

 - Build and maintain knowledge management platforms and learning and development programs that keep the team current and operating effectively.

 - Run the day-to-day operations of the Legal & team, driving efficiencies that enable the team to perform its best work (for example, manage vendors, contract signatures, attorney memberships, internal practice guidelines, expenses, team meetings).



Contract Lifecycle Management

 - Serve as the primary intake point for legal requests, triaging by urgency and complexity and routing to the right owner

 - Organize and consolidate incoming legal requests into a centralized tracking system

 - Handle baseline legal reviews and approvals directly, escalating complex or high-risk matters to legal counsel

 - Develop and maintain tooling and processes to track requests, contracts, and deadlines

 - Track responsible managers and renewal deadlines

 - Manage contract templates and organization (Vendor MSA, NDAs, offer letters)

 - Implement and maintain safeguards



Corporate and Compliance Matters

 - Assist in strategic corporate transactions, including due diligence and virtual data room building

 - Support post-closing integrations and follow-ups

 - Manage annual filings, updates, and deadline tracking

 - Prepare and update internal company policies

 - Prepare and update team trainings on legal issue spotting, privacy, governance, and HR

 - Track and implement updates to website and privacy policy terms

 - Organize and maintain general records

 - Prepare checklists and provide project support as needed



Data Privacy

 - Track data subject requests (deletions) and assist preparing transparency reporting

 - Organize and maintain data maps

 - Coordinate and track data protection impact assessments



Required Skills & Experience

 - Minimum of 5 years of proven legal administrative experience

 - Motivation to grow and expand knowledge base

 - Strong attention to detail and proofreading ability

 - Ability to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously and work independently to complete tasks within given deadlines



Bonus Points

 - High growth startup experience

 - Experience building out lean legal teams to carry out corporate responsibilities

jobs.description:
Position Title: Produce Clerk - Full Time

Position Type: Full time

Job Requisition ID: 49560

Banner: Food Basics

Employment Type: Permanent

This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement.

This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position

Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need.

Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team!

What Youâll Do

  • Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler.
  • Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness.
  • Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly.
  • Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items.
  • Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards.
  • Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions.
  • Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments.
  • Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce.
  • Answer customer inquiries and address concerns.
  • Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed.
  • Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly.
  • Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly.
  • Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed.
  • Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies.
  • Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items.
  • Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information.
  • Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items.
  • Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices.
  • Reduce and price items as needed.
  • Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines.
  • Use equipment and tools safely and properly.
  • Report any safety concerns or incidents to management.
  • Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed.
  • Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management.
  • Collaborate with other departments as needed.
  • Additional duties assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Customer service driven.
  • Able to stock merchandise and create displays.
  • Good product knowledge and attention to detail.
  • Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds.
  • Retail experience is considered an asset.
  • Able to stand for extend periods of time.
  • Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

The responsibilities and relationships assigned to this role may change as is necessary to achieve Metro's business objectives.

API Solutions Architect (f/m/d)

Team spirit and initiative are your most prominent strengths, and you are motivated to develop a long-term career in Intellectual Property, in a multicultural work environment? Apply now!

About Dennemeyer X-Labs

Dennemeyer X-Labs is the pioneering software arm of Dennemeyer, a global leader in Intellectual Property (IP) services. Our three pillars — Disruptive Products, Innovative Platforms, and New Ventures—drive cutting-edge solutions such as an AI-powered patent search platform (Octimine), a free IP Management System for small corporates, the IP Lounge SaaS platform (gateway to Dennemeyer services), and an internal GPT platform boosting efficiency with Agentic AI. We also forge strategic partnerships, integrating third-party IPMS with Dennemeyer's extensive IP service offerings. Let us disrupt the IP Industry together.

About the role

Digitizing and commercializing IP services is one of the fastest-growing opportunities in our industry, and Dennemeyer is at the forefront of that expansion. We are looking for an API Integration Specialist to collaborate with the Head of Software Partnerships and the back-end team. In this role, you will engage with software vendors and enterprise clients to lead discovery sessions, develop integration plans, and translate client needs into effective technical designs. As Dennemeyer's technical representative, you will enhance our API strategy and foster long-term partnerships.

Your Responsibilities

• Design and evolve API services, endpoints, and integration patterns for third-party IP platforms
• Identify and drive new API features and services based on partner needs and market opportunities
• Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with clients and vendors
• Translate business and technical requirements into clear API specifications and integration architectures
• Act as technical advisor in client meetings, explaining solutions and guiding integration approaches
• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and secure API implementations
• Create and maintain high-quality API documentation and developer enablement materials

Your Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree
• + 5 years of experience in API architecture, backend development, or solution architecture
• Strong expertise in .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core), API design, and distributed systems
• Experience with microservices, DDD, and modern integration patterns
• Proven ability to communicate technical concepts to external stakeholders and lead technical discussions
• Fluent in English and German, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset

Join and grow with us!

• Develop and customize your long-time career within a fast growing multinational company
• Enjoy working in multicultural teams and contribute to a diverse and international working environment
• Organize your lifestyle with flexible working hours
• Take the opportunity to act independently and entrepreneurial in your area of responsibility and profit from flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
• Celebrate success together as one team at our various corporate events
• Attend a tailor-made onboarding program as well as individual training & development opportunities
• Contribute through your personality and your daily work to make an impact on our business, corporate culture, society and environment

Dennemeyer does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.description:
Head of MI & Reporting
Finance - Group - UI0801 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

About Waystone  

Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion.

Summary:

The Head of MI & Reporting is the engine room of Group FP&A's management information function. The role owns the monthly MI cycle end-to-end  from data aggregation and system integrity through to investor-grade reporting and executive presentations- and leads two direct reports in delivering that cycle with rigour and consistency. Critically, this role is the integrating layer between the FP&A business partners and the broader finance function. Success depends on aligning inputs across the team, driving standardisation in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, and ensuring that reporting outputs are consistently high-quality, actionable and suited to an executive audience.
          
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MI & Investor Reporting

• Own the monthly Group MI pack end-to-end: production, commentary, quality control and delivery to FP&A leadership, Waystone Executive team and investors, on time and to a consistently high standard.
• Lead all standard investor reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis; manage ad-hoc queries from investors promptly and accurately.
• Own the Group reporting calendar, ensuring all key reporting requirements are known, tracked and executed by the FP&A team.
• Produce flash revenue reporting across legal entities, countries and product structures, with KPI and trend analysis that gives management a clear and timely read on performance.

FP&A Systems, Data & analytics

• Own the FP&A systems and toolset, ensuring data is well-controlled, models are scalable, and that new data sources are integrated in a structured and controlled way.
• Ensuring that the structuring of our data leads to improvements in our data quality/governance, and also surfaces relevant data in a more impactful way
• Comfortable with driving finance systems & finance process efficiency. You will identify and drive positive change to system structures and related processes which will support FP&A in raising our level.
• Experienced in driving automation in financial processes, and curious about the deployment of AI tooling to support efficiencies or deeper insights.
• Drive standardisation across the team in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, reducing reliance on fragmented individual processes and moving to consistent, repeatable approaches.
• Coordinate the wider FP&A team to engage with Financial Control with the goal of addressing potential General Ledger integrity issues or identifying improvements to ERP data entry to enhance reporting.
• Work with relevant departments to gather client revenue and cost of sales data for analytical purposes, building reliable data flows that FP&A can depend on.

Revenue Analysis & Forward-Looking Insight

• Deliver monthly analysis on Opportunities, Wins and Onboarding to provide forward-looking insight into revenue trends and the pipeline impact on future performance.
• Connect revenue run-rate and ARR outputs (built by the wider FP&A team) into the MI reporting suite so that executives have a consistent view of both current and forward performance.
• Identify performance trends, anomalies and risks in the data and surface these with clear, well-evidenced commentary in the MI materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Partner across FP&A and broader Finance function to co-ordinate the annual budget process for revenue and cost of sales, ensuring alignment of inputs and consistent methodology.
• Co-ordinate the quarterly revenue and cost of sales forecasting process with the country business partners.
• Prepare high-quality presentation materials to support budgeting and forecasting conversations with senior stakeholders.

Business Partnering & Coordination

• Act as the integrating layer between FP&A business partners and the MI function - aligning inputs, resolving data conflicts, ensuring all FP&A output is consistent across the various reporting layers and ensuring that what goes into the monthly pack reflects a single, agreed version of the truth.
• Collaborate with Country and Product leadership to provide financial guidance and ensure MI outputs are relevant, actionable and understood by the business.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with all key internal and external stakeholders, including investors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two, setting clear priorities, defining reporting outputs and creating an environment where the team can do their best work.
• Continuously evolve how the team measures and presents performance, always seeking to increase the actionable impact of the analysis.
• Raise the bar on presentation quality across the team, ensuring all outputs - whether for internal leadership or external investors — are executive-ready.

REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience:

• 10+ years post-qualified finance experience, with a meaningful proportion in FP&A or financial reporting in a complex, multi-entity environment.
• Proven track record of producing high-quality MI and management reporting for a senior or executive audience.
• Experience owning or managing financial planning and reporting systems, with a strong understanding of data flows and model architecture.
• Demonstrable ability to work with large, complex data sets- extracting insight, identifying anomalies and communicating findings clearly.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant messaging for non-finance audiences.
• Experience managing and developing direct reports.
• Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.

Desirable

• Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or similar BI and automation tooling; a track record of improving reporting efficiency through technology.
• Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Adaptive Planning or Salesforce.
• Experience in financial services, asset management or a similarly data-intensive, multi-jurisdiction business.

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent) preferred
