jobs.title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Montør av Plasthaller. Installation Worker for Fabric Halls and Steel Construction
jobs.description:
We are a company working with the assembly, disassembly and maintenance of fabric halls (PVC halls) and warehouse halls of all sizes and for various purposes throughout Norway, and occasionally abroad. We are now looking for additional employees to join our installation team.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for motivated and hardworking people who are not afraid to take responsibility and get the job done.

You enjoy physical work and working at height, and you are comfortable using lifts and working on construction sites.

You like travelling and working at different locations around Norway.

You can work independently, while also working well as part of a team.

You are reliable, engaged and take pride in your work.

You enjoy challenges and want to learn and develop in a professional working environment.

Experience with steel construction assembly and/or installation of fabric halls (PVC halls) is a strong advantage.

You must be able to understand and communicate safety instructions in English .

Norwegian language skills are a strong advantage.

A valid driving licence (class B) is required.

Lift and forklift certificates are an advantage, but not required -- training can be provided.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Assembly and disassembly of fabric halls (PVC halls) in various sizes and types.

This includes installation of steel structures and PVC fabric as cladding.

A lot of the work is performed at height using lifts, so fear of heights is not suitable for this job.

Steel structures are assembled on the ground, lifted into position using a crane, and completed before the fabric is installed.

The work also includes a significant amount of manual tasks such as measuring and anchoring base plates, assembling small and large steel components, and tensioning the fabric.

Extensive travel is required, as we carry out assignments ranging from one-day repair jobs to large projects lasting several weeks, all across Norway.

Vi tilbyr

We offer full training and exciting challenges in a growing company.

All necessary courses and certifications are provided, so you will be properly trained for the job.

We offer competitive salary and good working conditions.

You will have an independent and varied job with freedom under responsibility and the opportunity to develop your skills.

The position involves extensive travel, allowing you to experience many different locations, work at varied sites, and meet new people all the time.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a well-established and growing company specialising in all aspects of fabric halls, including assembly, disassembly, relocation and maintenance of fabric halls and warehouse halls of all sizes and applications.

With our office and warehouse in Krøderen, we deliver projects across Norway and occasionally abroad, offering varied workdays and exciting challenges.

We work with both small and large clients within industries such as industry, agriculture, transport and logistics.

Today, our team consists of 18 skilled installation workers and 10 fully equipped service vehicles, providing the right tools and support to deliver high-quality work.

Founded in 2005, we have nearly 20 years of experience and are a stable employer with strong expertise in our field.

Our vision is to build high-quality solutions and create a great workplace for everyone, while striving to be the best in our industry through quality, safety and teamwork.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions
  • Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality
  • Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach
  • Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production
  • Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

  • Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder
  • Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality
  • Can read and understand technical drawings
  • Are reliable and a team player
  • Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment
  • Speak Danish and/or English
  • Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

jobs.title: Steel Fitters Wanted
jobs.description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·     English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

 

Experience:

  • Experience is good to have but that's not necessary

We Offer you:

·         Full time job in Denmark 

·         Danish contract signed with Scan Con Construction, work for Scan Con Construction

·         Attractive salary (also vacation money, Free Choice Account, Labor market pension)

·         We guarantee 37 hours per week with possibilities for overtime (The normal average weekly working hours are according to the Union agreement as well as any local agreements)

·         Flight tickets

·         Transport to/ from job 

·         Accommodation 

·         Safety courses

·         Work tools and clothes

·         Help with applying for a residence and work permit after the Fast track scheme

·         Health insurance / Medical help

 

INTERESTED?

If you have any questions about the position, or if you wish to apply, you are welcome to contact Magda Kosecka HR Administrator on phone: +45 32 82 00 00 or send your application to cv@scan-con.dk – in e-mail title please write references: Steel Fitters

jobs.title: RenTid søger 4 nye kollegaer til vores team! - RenTid is looking for 4 new colleagues to join our team!
jobs.description:
✨ RenTid søger 4 nye kollegaer til vores team! ✨

RenTid er en professionel rengøringsvirksomhed i Aarhus, hvor kvalitet, grundighed og professionalisme er kernen i alt, hvad vi laver. Vi leverer rengøring ud over det sædvanlige, og derfor søger vi medarbejdere, der deler vores høje standarder.

Vi søger lige nu 4 deltidsansatte til rengøring i dagtimerne, mandag til fredag.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Minimum 15 timer om ugen

  • Arbejde primært i dagtimerne, mandag til fredag

  • Mulighed for flere timer og på sigt en fuldtidsstilling

  • Attraktiv løn, der afspejler vores høje standarder og forventninger

  • En virksomhed i vækst, hvor dygtige, stabile og engagerede medarbejdere bliver værdsat

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med professionel rengøring – dette er et krav

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljerne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som effektivt i et team

  • Er stabil, pålidelig og møder til tiden

  • Straffeattest skal fremvises

  • Tager ansvar for dit arbejde og den kvalitet, du leverer

  • Forstår, at rengøring hos RenTid ikke blot handler om at få arbejdet gjort – det handler om at levere et resultat, vi kan være stolte af

  • Ønsker at være en del af en virksomhed, hvor kvalitet altid kommer før kvantitet

Hos RenTid stiller vi høje krav til kvaliteten af vores arbejde – men vi mener også, at arbejde af høj kvalitet skal belønnes derefter. Derfor tilbyder vi en konkurrencedygtig løn, der afspejler din erfaring, dit ansvar og den kvalitet, vi forventer.

Arbejdsområde: Aarhus og omegn
Arbejdstid: Dagtimer, mandag–fredag
⏱️ Timer: Fra 15 timer om ugen med mulighed for at udvikle sig til en fuldtidsstilling

Har du erfaring med professionel rengøring, arbejder du godt både selvstændigt og i et team, og går du ikke på kompromis med kvaliteten? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv og din tidligere erfaring med professionel rengøring.

English*

✨ RenTid is looking for 4 new colleagues to join our team! ✨

RenTid is a professional cleaning company based in Aarhus, where quality, attention to detail, and professionalism are at the heart of everything we do. We provide cleaning services beyond the ordinary, and we are therefore looking for employees who share the same high standards.

We are currently looking for 4 part-time cleaning professionals for daytime work, Monday to Friday.

We offer:

  • A minimum of 15 hours per week

  • Work primarily during daytime hours, Monday to Friday

  • The opportunity for more hours and potentially a full-time position

  • Attractive pay that reflects our high standards and expectations

  • A growing company where skilled, reliable, and dedicated employees are valued

We expect you to:

  • Have previous professional cleaning experience – this is a MUST

  • Be thorough and have a strong eye for detail

  • Be able to work independently as well as effectively as part of a team

  • Be reliable, trustworthy, and punctual

  • A criminal record certificate must be presented.

  • Take responsibility for your work and the quality you deliver

  • Understand that cleaning at RenTid is not simply about getting the job done – it is about delivering a result we can be proud of

  • Want to be part of a company where quality always comes before quantity

At RenTid, we have high expectations when it comes to the quality of our work – but we also believe that high-quality work should be rewarded accordingly. That is why we offer competitive pay that reflects your experience, responsibility, and the level of quality we expect.

Work area: Aarhus and surrounding areas
Working hours: Daytime, Monday–Friday
⏱️ Hours: From 15 hours per week, with the possibility of progressing to full-time employment

Do you have professional cleaning experience, work well both independently and in a team, and refuse to compromise on quality? Then we would love to hear from you.

Send us a short application telling us a little about yourself and your previous cleaning experience.

jobs.title: Supervisor
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Sola lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Varierende (dag, kveld og helg – her skjer det alltid noe)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - vi intervjuer fortløpende

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Som Supervisor er du stasjonsleders høyre hånd og selve motoren i den daglige driften. Du sørger for at kundene våre får en sømløs, profesjonell og minneverdig opplevelse, hver eneste gang.

Dette er en rolle for deg som elsker mennesker, tempo og ansvar. Du har full oversikt over logistikk, bilflåte, salg og nøkkeltall, samtidig som du inspirerer teamet ditt til å levere på topp, også når pulsen er høy. Rollen passer spesielt godt for deg som allerede har erfaring fra service, salg eller drift og som ønsker mer ansvar og ledelse.

Du er til stede. Du leder. Du leverer.

Slik skaper du magi i hverdagen

  • Levere eksepsjonell kundeservice - alltid

  • Presentere og selge våre produkter på en god, trygg og elegant måte

  • Håndtere kundehenvendelser via telefon og e-post med presisjon og service i fokus

  • Er en tydelig rollemodell på service, salg og etterlevelse.

  • Optimalisere daglige reservasjoner opp mot tilgjengelig bilflåte

  • Følge opp nøkkeltall og være stasjonsleders stedfortreder i det daglige

  • Motivere, coache og utvikle medarbeidere

  • Rapportering og øvrige administrative oppgaver

  • Operativ ledelse i høyt tempo.

Hvem er du?

Du er en naturlig vert. En som tar eierskap, setter standarden og liker å være den andre stoler på og kan henvende seg til. Du brenner for service, har teft for salg og motiveres av å skape Premium-opplevelser - både for kunder og kolleger.

Du:

  • Har minimum førerkort klasse B (manuell og automat)

  • Har plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Er serviceinnstilt, trygg i møte med mennesker og sterk relasjonsbygger

  • Har gode salgsferdigheter og kommersiell forståelse

  • Er strukturert og trives med logistikk i en dynamisk hverdag

  • Har lederegenskaper, integritet og gjennomslagskraft

  • Behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Har gode data-kunnskaper

Hva får du hos oss?

Som Supervisor hos Sixt Bilutleie får du mer enn bare en jobb. Du får en arena der du kan vokse, påvirke og sette tydelige spor. Du blir en del av en variert og utfordrende hverdag med høyt tempo, der du får muligheten til å lede og forme et engasjert team. Hos oss jobber du sammen med dyktige kolleger i et sterkt fellesskap, og får tilgang til trenings- og utviklingsprogrammer som gir deg både trygghet og utvikling i rollen. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, og for den rette finnes det reelle karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter videre i organisasjonen.

Hvis du ønsker en rolle der du blir sett, hørt og gitt tillit, da er dette muligheten for deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Engineer - SeaQ Communication
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Engineer - SeaQ Communications to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Technical responsibility for system groups; ICT infrastructure, networking, voice communication, CCTV and infotainment
  • Act as technical expert for scope of responsibility. Provide support for the organization together with the team.
  • Participate in, or drive projects and cases within SeaQ Communication scope.
  • Hands-on work in testing and pre-commissioning
  • Support to on-site commissioning and service cases
  • Expected some travel domestic and abroad
Qualifications
  • Education; College/University or Vocational School within IT/Telecom
  • Preferred qualifications to design, configure and commission CCTV systems
  • Relevant experience, instead of schooling, will be considered
  • Language; English fluent verbally, and good written, as minimum
  • Preferred experience; 5 years of development and/or delivery of ICT and/or security systems and solutions
  • A plus for experience working within the maritime industry

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Independent and proactive
  • Structured
  • Good ability to adapt to changes
  • Interest in the subject and willing to learn more
  • Problem-solving mentality with ability to plan under pressure
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking

jobs.description:
Společnost EKOBAL ROŽNOV s.r.o. hledá údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů
Jsme stabilní a rostoucí výrobní společnost s dlouholetou tradicí na trhu. Zakládáme si na kvalitě našich produktů a efektivitě výrobních procesů. Přidejte se k týmu, který udržuje naše klíčové výrobní linky v chodu.
Jsi zručný mechanik s technickým myšlením a složité stroje ti nejsou cizí? Máte rád, když věci šlapou jako hodinky a umíte je rychle najít a opravit, když se něco zadrhne? Pak hledáme přesně Vás!

Co bude Vaše hlavní náplň práce?
•    Preventivní a operativní údržba a opravy poloautomatizovaných kelímkvacích strojů (mechanická, pneumatická, elektrická část). Budete mozek a ruce našich poloautomatických kelímkovacích stroje.
•    Přestavba a seřizování kelímkovacích strojů při přechodu na jiný typ a velikost kelímku. Preciznost je klíč.
•    Diagnostika a odstraňování závad kelímkovacích strojů a  periférních zařízení. Vedení evidence oprav a údržby v SW Klid
•    Zajištění plynulého chodu výroby a minimalizace prostojů. Starat se o to, aby naše stroje jely nonstop a bez poruch (servis, mazání, kontrola – prostě prevence).
•    Spolupráce s oddělením výroby, technologie a kvality. Žádné stereotypy, každý den je jiný problém k vyřešení!
•    Drobné zámečnické práce a práce s nástroji. Výběr a udržování pohotovostního skladu náhradních dílů. Úzká spolupráce s externími firmami při zajišťování speciálních dílů a dalších prací.
Co od Vás očekáváme?
•    Minimálně SŠ/SOU v oboru mechanik, provozní zámečník, elektrikář, mechatronik nebo jiném relevantním technickém oboru.
•    Praxe na obdobné pozici (údržba/seřizování výrobních nebo balicích linek) je velkou výhodou a Vaše eso v rukávu.
•    Znalost elektrotechniky, mechaniky, pneumatiky/hydrauliky.
•    Platná vyhláška 50/1978 Sb.
•    Schopnost číst technickou dokumentaci a výkresy.
•    Samostatnost, spolehlivost a ochota pracovat ve směnném provozu.
Co Vám nabízíme?
•    Stabilní zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr ve firmě s pevnou pozicí na trhu.
•    Motivační finanční ohodnocení a systém prémií dle dosažených výsledků
•    4 týdny dovolené a zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkový paušál/ příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, firemní akce).
•    Možnost profesního rozvoje a odborných školení.
•    Moderní pracovní prostředí a technické vybavení.

jobs.description:
Společnost EKOBAL ROŽNOV s.r.o. hledá Operátora výroby
Jsme stabilní a rostoucí výrobní společnost s dlouholetou tradicí na trhu. Zakládáme si na kvalitě našich produktů a efektivitě výrobních procesů. Přidejte se k týmu, který udržuje naše klíčové výrobní linky v chodu.
Jsi zručný mechanik s technickým myšlením a složité stroje ti nejsou cizí? Máte rád, když věci šlapou jako hodinky a umíte je rychle najít a opravit, když se něco zadrhne? Pak hledáme přesně Vás!
Co bude Vaše hlavní náplň práce?
•    Mastering strojů: budeš mít pod palcem naše výrobní linky. Nejde jen o obsluhu, ale o precizní seřizování – ty budeš ten, kdo udává tempo.

•    Oko profíka: kvalita je pro nás svatá. Tvým úkolem bude hlídat, aby z linky sjížděly jen top produkty.

•    Flow materiálu: zajistíš, aby vše bylo ve správný čas na správném místě. Od surovin až po finální masterpiece.

•    Safe & Smart: pracujeme s nejnovějšími postupy. Bezpečnost a technologie u nás jdou ruku v ruce.

•    Směnový rytmus: Máme systém směn, který ti umožní efektivně plánovat volný čas i práci.

Co od Vás očekáváme?
•    Manuální zručnost a fyzická zdatnost.
•    Praxe na obdobné pozici je velkou výhodou a Vaše eso v rukávu.
•    Pečlivost, zodpovědnost a spolehlivost
•    Schopnost pracovat v týmu
•    Ochota pracovat ve směnném provozu

Co Vám nabízíme?
•    Stabilní zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr ve firmě s pevnou pozicí na trhu.
•    Motivační finanční ohodnocení a systém prémií dle dosažených výsledků
•    4 týdny dovolené a zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkový paušál, 3x sick days, firemní akce).
•    Možnost profesního rozvoje a odborných školení.
•    Moderní pracovní prostředí a technické vybavení.
Místo výkonu práce: Pivovarská 42, Rožnov p/R
Nástup: Ihned nebo dle dohody

jobs.title: Zkušený autoelektrikář pro Auto Dobrovolný (m/ž), Mechanici a opraváři osobních automobilů
jobs.description:
O společnosti
Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí. Máme přes 90 zaměstnanců ve třech provozovnách – Velké Meziříčí, Jihlava a Znojmo – a silné servisní zázemí. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAP motor a nabízíme stabilní zaměstnání, férový přístup a smysluplnou práci.
Koho hledáme
Do naší pobočky v ŠKODA ve Velkém Meziříčí hledáme zkušeného parťáka, nadšence do osobních aut, který ocení moderní vybavení dílny a je otevřen novým technologiím, které automobilky v oblasti elektromobility nabízí. Hledáme člověka, který se nebojí nových výzev a je otevřen se učit. Pokud Vám někde chybí zkušenosti – vše doučíme. Důležité je, aby Vás práce bavila a byl na Vás spoleh.
Náplň práce
•    Práce s řídicími jednotkami, elektronikou, asistenty, senzory a dalšími systémy.
•    Diagnostika a opravy poškozených vozidel (světla, startéry, alternátory, pohonné systémy hybridů a elektro).
•    Spolupráce s kolegy v moderním servisním zázemí a koordinace oprav.
•    Využití diagnostické techniky k rychlému a kvalitnímu řešení.
Požadavky
•    Vyučení v oboru autotronik/autoelektrikář nebo mechanik (případně SŠ s praxí).
•    Manuální zručnost a schopnost pracovat samostatně i v týmu.
•    Technické myšlení, pečlivost a spolehlivost.
•    Nadšení do aut, touha učit se nové technologie (hybridy, elektro).
•    Řidičský průkaz sk. B (nutnost).
Co nabízíme
•    20 dní dovolené + 5 sick days ročně
•    Příspěvek na obědy
•    Vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce
•    Výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servisní úkony

jobs.title: Dělníci v oblasti výstavby a údržby budov, Dělníci v oblasti výstavby a údržby budov
English Teacher
jobs.description:
• Full-time, ongoing
  • Commencing Term 1, 2027
  • Salary commensurate with years of Service
  • Continuous professional development opportunities
  • Generous staff benefits


English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.


About the Role

Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.


Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
  • Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
  • Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
  • Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
  • Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.


About You

You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.


You will bring:

  • Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
  • Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
  • Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
  • Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
  • A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life


Applications at All Career Stages

We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.


Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

  • Current Working with Children Check (South Australia)
  • Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices
  • First Aid and CPR


Find Your Place At Pembroke

At Pembroke, youâll be part of a warm and collaborative school community that values relationships, initiative, and a shared commitment to learning. Whether in the classroom, on the sporting field, or behind the scenes, every role contributes to shaping the rich and inclusive culture of the School. With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.


Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.


Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).


Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.


Pembroke seeks to engage outstanding, diverse and well-qualified staff to work in our welcoming and open School. All staff work together to provide an environment that facilitates each studentâs exploration of their potential, academic progress and personal welfare. Staff are encouraged to maintain a collaborative approach, a broad outlook within their respective field and a commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. Pembroke is a lively and fulfilling place to work.


How to Apply

Applications for this position close on Sunday, 6 September 2026, at 11:59 pm.


  • You are required to upload a CV and a cover letter (maximum 2 pages) identifying your interest in applying and what you could bring to the role.
  • Your application should be addressed to the Acting Principal, Mr Chris Zielinski.
  • The School reserves the right to shortlist and interview candidates before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
  • For any enquiries regarding this position, please email talent@pembroke.sa.edu.au
  • Please do not email your applications.
  • Late applications and those submitted via external recruitment agencies will not be considered.


Pembroke School is an equal opportunity employer.

At Pete's Frootique & Fine Foods, we're passionate about providing our customers with the freshest, highest-quality products and exceptional service. As a Meat & Seafood Clerk, you'll play an important role in creating an outstanding shopping experience by delivering knowledgeable, friendly service and maintaining an inviting, well-stocked department.

  • Create attractive, fully stocked displays that showcase the quality and freshness of our products.
  • Ensure all products meet Pete's high standards for food safety, quality, and presentation.
  • Share product knowledge with customers, including cooking tips and preparation suggestions.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Support your team with daily department operations and other duties as required.

What We're Looking For

  • A positive, enthusiastic attitude and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.
  • A genuine interest in quality food and helping customers find the right products.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • A willingness to learn new skills and grow within the department.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends.

Experience in a meat, seafood, grocery, or food service environment is considered an asset but is not requiredâwe're happy to train the right candidate who shares our passion for great food and exceptional customer service.

jobs.title: Receiver
jobs.description:
Our Receiving team plays a vital role in keeping the store running smoothly. This fast-paced position is responsible for receiving, inspecting, and organizing incoming deliveries to ensure our departments are fully stocked with the freshest, highest-quality products.

As a Receiver, you will accurately verify deliveries for quality and quantity, organize inventory efficiently, and rotate stock to maintain freshness and minimize waste. During slower periods, you will support the Produce Department with a variety of tasks, making you an important part of our overall store team.

This position requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, physical stamina, and a positive, team-oriented attitude. You must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. A valid driver's license may be required, and applicants must meet company insurability requirements where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Positive, enthusiastic, and dependable attitude.
  • Passion for food and delivering quality.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Commitment to providing outstanding customer service.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to learn new skills and take on a variety of responsibilities.
  • Team player with strong communication skills.
  • Ability to frequently lift up to 50 lbs.

Join Our Team

If you enjoy staying active, take pride in keeping things organized, and want to be part of a team that values quality, teamwork, and exceptional service, we'd love to hear from you. Join Pete's Frootique & Fine Foods and help ensure our customers enjoy the freshest products every day.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Digital Banking and Mobile Application (m/f) - SP
jobs.description:
Description:

Context

For one of our clients, a leading financial institution, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager - Digital Banking & Mobile Applications to manage the delivery and continuous improvement of customer-facing mobile banking solutions.

The role combines end-to-end project management with strong coordination across business, IT, UX/UI, security, compliance, and external technology partners. You will ensure that digital banking initiatives are delivered within the agreed scope, budget, and timeline while meeting customer experience, security, regulatory, and operational requirements.

Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, developers, testing teams, and vendors, you will support the full delivery lifecycle - from project initiation and requirements definition through testing, deployment, and post-release stabilization.

Key Responsibilities:

- Digital Banking Project Delivery
- Lead digital banking and mobile application projects from initiation through successful implementation.
- Define and manage project scope, objectives, planning, budget, timelines, resources, risks, dependencies, and delivery roadmaps.
- Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, and technology partners throughout the project lifecycle.
- Ensure projects are delivered in line with business expectations, technical constraints, and operational requirements.

Mobile Application Delivery:

- Manage the delivery of new mobile banking features, customer journeys, and application enhancements.
- Coordinate Product Owners, business analysts, UX/UI specialists, architects, developers, and testing teams.
- Maintain alignment between business requirements, solution design, development activities, testing, and delivery priorities.
- Coordinate mobile application releases, transition into production, post-release monitoring, and stabilization.
- Governance & Stakeholder Management
- Establish appropriate project governance, reporting, and decision-making processes.
- Prepare and maintain project plans, steering committee materials, status reports, risk registers, and delivery documentation.
- Provide clear visibility on project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies.
- Facilitate communication across business, IT, operations, compliance, and senior management, while supporting timely escalation and issue resolution.
- Coordinate third-party providers and monitor the quality and timely delivery of their commitments.
- Quality, Risk & Regulatory Alignment
- Ensure digital banking solutions meet internal quality, security, and operational standards.
- Coordinate testing activities, including system integration testing, User Acceptance Testing, and business validation.
- Monitor defects, delivery risks, and remediation actions through to closure.
- Ensure relevant regulatory, data protection, cybersecurity, and accessibility requirements are integrated into the delivery process.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of digital delivery methods, governance processes, and ways of working.

Required Profile:

- Proven experience as a Project Manager, Digital Project Manager, or IT Project Manager within complex technology environments.
- Strong experience delivering digital platforms, customer-facing applications, or mobile applications.
- Experience managing projects across the complete delivery lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation and stabilization.
- Good understanding of mobile application development, digital product delivery, and Agile or hybrid methodologies.
- Strong project governance, planning, risk management, and reporting capabilities.
- Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and external technology providers.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
- Fluent in French and English.

Résumé français:

Gestion et coordination de projets de transformation IT et digitale auprès des clients de BTO Research. Analyse et formalisation des besoins, définition et suivi des plans projets, coordination des différentes parties prenantes métiers et IT, suivi des risques, dépendances, budgets et délais, préparation du reporting projet et des comités de gouvernance. Participation aux activités de conseil de BTO, à la structuration des livrables clients et à l'application des méthodologies et standards internes de gestion de projet.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant in Valuation Assurance - Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Consultant Valuation
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1702399
  
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

At EY, we support you in achieving your unique potential — both personally and professionally. We give you stretching and rewarding experiences that keep you motivated, working in an atmosphere of integrity and teaming with some of the world's most successful companies. And while we encourage you to take personal responsibility for your career, we support you in your professional development in every way we can. You enjoy the flexibility to devote time to what matters to you, in your business and personal lives. At EY you can be who you are and express your point of view, energy, and enthusiasm, wherever you are in the world. It's how you make a difference.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant FAAS // Valuation - September 2026, your responsibilities will be to perform and carry out valuation analysis and reviews of a wide spectrum of assets (Private Equity, Private Debt, as well as Intangible assets) in assessing the reasonableness of valuations and financial models in the context of financial reporting and assurance related engagements.

• Perform valuations for alternative investments e.g. Infrastructure, Private Credit, Private Equity or Venture Capital.
• Lead, coordinate, and develop a team of Assistants, ensuring effective execution of engagements.Build and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel and assess client satisfaction.
• Apply deep understanding of complex valuation concepts to real-world client scenarios.
• Coordinate on-site fieldwork at client locations, liaising with other departments to ensure smooth audit delivery.
• Responsible for contributing to the delivery of one or more processes, solutions and/or projects by delivering agreed activities, applying judgement, and selecting appropriate methodologies to inform recommendations, considerate of success criteria, barriers, risks, and issues.
• Accountable for meeting own targets which impact the immediate team.May help coordinate the work of junior colleagues or team members.
• Meets performance objectives and metrics set locally (client service, quality and risk management, sales and business growth, solution development and teaming etc.)
• Anticipate risk, team effectively across EY and identify opportunities to enhance trust, focusing on:Overall quality, building deep relationships, and value creation through independence and client understanding.
• Account strategy and delivery, maximizing the possibilities from data and technology

Skills and attributes for success

• You have 2 – 3 years of experience in a similar role (e.g. Transaction services, M&A, Private Equity, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance);
• Graduate from an economics, business and/or management school with a focus in finance.
• Excellent academic background.
• Advanced theoretical and practical knowledge of valuation principles and techniques (income, market approach) with regards to business valuation.
• Strong analytical skills, problem solver, detail-oriented, entrepreneurial, autonomous and enjoy working in a multi-cultural environment.
• Being flexible when adapting to changing client needs and market conditions.
• Ability to manage multiple threads of tasks and / or engagements.
• Proven ability to mentor and guide junior team members and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
• Sound knowledge of recognized valuation guidelines, such as IPEV guidelines.
• Sound knowledge of industry software and tools (i.e. S&P CapIQ, and/or advanced Excel modelling).
• Perfect command of English, both written and verbally, within a professional services business environment.
• Receptive feedback and reflection to develop strengths and address developmental areas.
• Seeks and embraces opportunities to gain exposure to a wide spectrum of reviews.
• Command of French or German language is an asset, and additional language would be considered as a plus.
• PC proficiency including MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Professional qualification in progress (CFA, CAIA, ACA, RICS…) is a plus.

What we offer you

• As Senior, you will lead a multicultural team of high performing individuals
• Enhance your technical expertise and leadership skills through tailored development programs designed to meet the demands of tomorrow.
• Expand your horizons by collaborating with diverse teams across the globe, gaining insights from professionals with varied backgrounds and perspectives.
• Define your purpose and contribute to building a better working world, both within EY and in society at large.
• Receive comprehensive training and coaching to solidify your technical skills and pursue professional certifications (ACCA/IRE).

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Our offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and pre-screening requirements. The candidate acknowledges that all information provided must be accurate.

jobs.title: OPERATER U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 4)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 2 smjene – prijepodne/poslijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.304,83 € do 1.500,60 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda
  • rukovanje s repromaterijalima i kemikalijama koje se koriste u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • dehidriranje otpadnog mulja,
  • nadopuna spremnika za kemikalije prema radnim postupcima,
  • skidanje korozije po opremi i zaštita odgovarajućim sredstvima,
  • pomaganje kod redovitih remonta i popravaka opreme i crpki,
  • održavanje alata,
  • održavanje travnjaka,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme (pranje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača, mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana, skidanje korozije, zaštita opreme odgovarajućim zaštitnim sredstvima..),
  • kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i po potrebi zamjena beskonačnih vreća za otpad,
  • pomoć oko čišćenja kod pražnjenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja…,
  • čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika,
  • obrada i dehidracija mulja, održavanje kontejnera za mulj čistim,
  • mjerenje koncentracije plinova prema radnim uputama,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar (pisarnica) ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

Rok za predaju prijava je 07.09.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično, bez navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK / POMOĆNICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description:
Opis poslova: pomoć u komunikaciji, izvršavanju školskih zadataka, pomoć pri kretanju, obavljanju higijenskih potreba te ostalim zadacima za vrijeme školskih i izvannastavnih aktivnosti, suradnja s učiteljima, roditeljima i stručnim suradnicima.

U sklopu projekta „Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko-goranskoj županiji“ koji se provodi u okviru instrumenta "Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama, faza VII." temeljem poziva Europskog socijalnog fonda u sklopu Operativnog programa "Učinkoviti ljudski potencijali" 2021. – 2027., Osnovna škola Jurja Klovića Tribalj koju zastupa ravnateljica Vilma Renate Car Katnić, prof. objavljuje

NATJEČAJ za prijavu kandidata za izvršavanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi

1. Pomoćnik u nastavi - dva izvršitelja/ice na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme od 27 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena

Na natječaj za radno mjesto mogu se ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu korišteni su neutralno i odnose se i na muške i ženske kandidate.

Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje korišteni u ovom natječaju odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod, bez obzira na to jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu.

U sklopu projekta „Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko-goranskoj županiji“ raspisuje se natječaj za izbor pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama, a koji su temeljem rješenja o primjerenom programu školovanja integrirani u redovni sustav osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja.

Posao pomoćnika u nastavi obuhvaća pomoć u komunikaciji, izvršavanju školskih zadataka, pomoć pri kretanju, obavljanju higijenskih potreba te ostalim zadacima za vrijeme školskih i izvannastavnih aktivnosti.

Od pomoćnika se očekuje otvorenost i spremnost za suradnju s učiteljima, roditeljima i stručnim suradnicima.

Uvjeti:

  • završeno najmanje četverogodišnje srednjoškolsko obrazovanje
  • protiv osobe nije pokrenut kazneni postupak ili koja je pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23).
  • završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi ili edukacija za pomoćnika

Uz potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  1. životopis
  2. dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja ( preslika diplome ili potvrda o stečenoj stručnoj spremi),
  3. dokaz o državljanstvu,
  4. potvrda o završenom programu edukacije odraslih odnosno edukacije za pomoćnika u nastavi,
  5. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  6. dokaz da kandidatu nije pravomoćno izrečena prekršajno pravna sankcija za nasilje u obitelji (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  7. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje.

Za vrijeme trajanja projekta s odabranim pomoćnicima sklopit će se ugovor o radu na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme kojim će se definirati međusobna prava i obaveze.

Odabrani pomoćnici obvezni su proći 20-satnu edukaciju za osposobljavanje za rad s učenicima s teškoćama, ukoliko kandidat nema završen program edukacije za poslove pomoćnika u nastavi u minimalnom trajanju od 20 sati

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo na prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo i priložiti dokument o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je navedeno pravo vidljivo te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se na adresu Osnovna škola Jurja Klovića Tribalj, Tribalj 21, 51243 Tribalj s naznakom: „NATJEČAJ ZA POMOĆNIKA U NASTAVI“

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Prije donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata, kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj čije su prijave pravodobne, potpune i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja bit će pozvani na razgovor (intervju) radi utvrđivanja njihovog znanja, radnih sposobnosti, interesa i motivacije temeljem kojih se može očekivati da će s uspjehom obavljati poslove pomoćnika u nastavi. O datumu, vremenu i mjestu održavanja razgovora (intervjua) s kandidatima isti će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Škole. Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru (intervjuu), smatra se da je povukao prijavu za natječaj. Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Osnovnoj školi Jurja Klovića Tribalj za prikupljanje, korištenje i obradu svih dostavljenih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka i objavom osobnih podataka (ime, prezime, titula) na mrežnoj stranici škole, u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja.
